        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadConversationDetail = \nasync (\n      conversationId: string,\n      options?: {\n        append?: boolean;\n        before?: string;\n      }\n    ) =&gt; {\n\n            \n            // 合并所有来源：现有来源 + 数据库来源（优先）+ 对话来源（仅当不在数据库中时）\n            setSources(prev =&gt; {\n              const sourceMap = new Map&lt;string, Source&gt;();\n              \n              // 1. 先添加现有的来源（包括页面类型的来源）\n              prev.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              // 2. 添加数据库中的来源（优先，因为已经过滤了已删除的记录）\n              dbSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              // 3. 添加对话中的来源（仅当不在数据库中时，避免重新添加已删除的来源）\n              conversationSources.forEach(s =&gt; {\n                // 如果来源不在数据库中，说明可能已被删除，不添加\n                // 如果来源在数据库中，说明是活跃的，已经在步骤2中添加了\n                if (!dbSourceIds.has(s.id)) {\n                  // 不在数据库中，可能是已删除的来源，不添加\n                  console.log('[SourceInfo] 跳过对话中的已删除来源:', s.id, s.title);\n                }\n              });\n              \n              const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\n              console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length, {\n                prev: prev.length,\n                conversation: conversationSources.length,\n                db: dbSources.length,\n                filtered: conversationSources.filter(s =&gt; !dbSourceIds.has(s.id)).length\n              });\n              return merged;\n            });\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error(\"[SourceInfo] 加载对话来源信息失败:\", error);\n            // 如果加载失败，不添加对话中的来源，因为可能包含已删除的来源\n    }\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst autoSaveConversationAsSource = async (conversation: Conversation | null) =&gt; {\nconst lastAssistantMessage = \n((m) =&gt; m.role === 'assistant');\n      \n      if (lastAssistantMessage &amp;&amp; lastAssistantMessage.content) {\n        // 取前100字符作为标题候选\n        const contentPreview = lastAssistantMessage.content.substring(0, 100).replace(/\\n/g, ' ').trim();\n        if (contentPreview.length &gt; 10) {\n          summaryTitle = contentPreview.length &gt; 50 \n            ? contentPreview.substring(0, 50) + '...'\n            : contentPreview;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 根据当前页面的 pageType 设置类别\n      let category: SourceCategory = 'external';\n      if (config.pageType === 'tech-package') {\n        category = 'tech-package-qa';\n      } else if (config.pageType === 'tech-strategy') {\n        category = 'tech-strategy-qa';\n      } else if (config.pageType === 'tech-article') {\n        category = 'tech-article-qa';\n      }\n\n      // 使用 conversation.id 作为 sourceId 的一部分，确保同一对话只保存一次\n      const sourceId = &#96;conversation_${conversation.id}_${config.pageType}&#96;;\n      \n      const source: Source = {\n        id: sourceId,\n        title: summaryTitle,\n        type: 'external',\n        description: summaryDescription,\n        category: category,\n      };\n\n      // 保存到数据库，传递 projectId 确保项目隔离\n      // 先检查是否已存在该对话的记录（使用 ref 避免依赖 sources）\n      const existingSources = sourcesRef.current.filter(s =&gt; s.id === sourceId);\n      \n      if (existingSources.length &gt; 0) {\n        // 如果已存在，更新它（通过删除旧的后创建新的）\n        try {\n          await sourceService.deleteSourceInformation(sourceId);\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.warn('[SourceInfo] 删除旧记录失败:', error);\n        }\n      }\n\n      const saveResult = await sourceService.saveSourceInformation(\n        source,\n        config.pageType,\n        conversation.id,\n        projectId || undefined\n      );\n\n      if\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadPageTypeSources = async () =&gt; {\n\n\n      });\n      \n      if (sourceResult.success &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载到的来源:', sourceResult.data.map(s =&gt; ({ id: s.id, title: s.title })));\n        setSources(prev =&gt; {\n          // 只保留文件来源（file_开头的），然后添加当前页面的来源\n          // 这样可以确保切换页面时只显示当前页面的来源\n          const fileSources = prev.filter(s =&gt; s.id.startsWith('file_'));\n          const pageTypeSources = sourceResult.data!;\n          \n          // 合并文件来源和页面类型来源\n          const sourceMap = new Map&lt;string, Source&gt;();\n          fileSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          pageTypeSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          \n          const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\n          console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length, {\n            fileSources: fileSources.length,\n            pageTypeSources: pageTypeSources.length\n          });\n          sourcesRef.current = merged;\n          return merged;\n        });\n      } else if (sourceResult.error) {\n        console.warn('[SourceInfo] 加载失败:', sourceResult.error);\n        // 即使加载失败，也要清除其他页面的来源，只保留文件来源\n        setSources(prev =&gt; {\n          const filtered = prev.filter(s =&gt; s.id.startsWith('file_'));\n          sourcesRef.current = filtered;\n          return filtered;\n        });\n      } else {\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 没有找到来源信息');\n        // 没有找到来源时，只保留文件来源\n        setSources(prev =&gt; {\n          const filtered = prev.filter(s =&gt; s.id.startsWith('file_'));\n          sourcesRef.current = filtered;\n          return filtered;\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"[SourceInfo] 加载来源信息失败:\", error);\n      // 不阻止页面加载，只记录错误\n    } finally {\n      isLoadingSourcesRef.current = false;\n    }\n  },;\n;",

uploadedFile.markdownContent.substring(0, 500) + '...'\n            : uploadedFile.markdownContent;\n          description = contentPreview;\n        }\n        \n        const sourceData = {\n          source_id: uploadedFile.id || uploadedFile.fileId || &#96;file_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}&#96;,\n          title: uploadedFile.name,\n          type: 'external' as const,\n          url: uploadedFile.url,\n          description: description,\n          page_type: undefined, // 不再使用 page_type，改用 project_id\n          conversation_id: null,\n          project_id: project.id, // 明确关联到当前项目\n          metadata: {\n            category: 'external' // 标记为外部文件\n          }\n        };\n        \n        try {\n          await api.post('/source-information', sourceData);\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('创建来源信息失败:', error);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 刷新文件列表\n      await loadData();\n      \n      // 清空文件输入\n      if (fileInputRef.current) {\n        fileInputRef.current.value = '';\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\n      alert('文件上传失败，请重试');\n    } finally {\n      setUploading(false);\n    }\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "const ResourceSidebar: React.FC&lt;ResourceSidebarProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const loadData = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n\n      // 加载资源（只加载当前项目的资源）\n      const sourcesResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByProjectId(project.id);\n      const sources = sourcesResult.success &amp;&amp; sourcesResult.data ? sourcesResult.data : [];\n      \n      // 分类资源：文件、互联网信息、知识点\n      // 文件：URL 是文件路径（包含 /uploads/ 或文件扩展名）\n      const files = sources.filter(s =&gt; {\n        const urlStr = s.url?.trim() || '';\n        return urlStr.startsWith('/uploads/') || \n               urlStr.startsWith('uploads/') || \n               urlStr.startsWith('/api/ai-search/files/') ||\n               urlStr.startsWith('/api/v1/public-knowledge/files/') ||\n               /\\.(pdf|doc|docx|txt|md|jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp|ppt|pptx)$/i.test(urlStr);\n      });\n      \n      // 互联网信息：URL 是 HTTP/HTTPS 链接，且不是文件路径\n      const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&gt; {\n        const urlStr = s.url?.trim() || '';\n        const isHttpUrl = urlStr.startsWith('http://') || urlStr.startsWith('https://');\n        const isFileUrl = urlStr.startsWith('/uploads/') || \n                         urlStr.startsWith('uploads/') ||\n                         urlStr.startsWith('/api/ai-search/files/') ||\n                         urlStr.startsWith('/api/v1/public-knowledge/files/');\n        // 通过 category 判断是否是互联网搜索或 web 搜索\n        const isInternetCategory = s.category === 'internet-search' || s.category === 'web-search';\n        return (isHttpUrl &amp;&amp; !isFileUrl) || isInternetCategory;\n      });\n\n      // 加载知识点（从项目详情中获取，这些是关联的知识点）\n      const detailsResponse = await api.get(&#96;/projects/${project.id}/details&#96;);\n      const knowledgePoints = detailsResponse.data?.success &amp;&amp; detailsResponse.data?.data?.knowledgePoints\n        ? detailsResponse.data.data.knowledgePoints\n        : [];\n\n      setResources({ files, internetInfo, knowledgePoints });\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const SourceSidebar: React.FC&lt;SourceSidebarProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const handleDeleteSource = (sourceId: string, e: React.MouseEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.stopPropagation(); // 阻止事件冒泡，防止触发编辑弹窗\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      const newSources = sources.filter((s) =&gt; s.id !== sourceId);\n      onSourcesChange(newSources);\n      if (onSelectionChange) {\n        onSelectionChange(\n          selectedSources.filter((id) =&gt; id !== sourceId)\n        );\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleAddExternalSource = (newSource: Omit&lt;Source, \"id\"&gt;) =&gt; {\n    const source: Source = {\n      ...newSource,\n      id: &#96;external_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n      category: newSource.category || 'external', // 确保有 category\n    };\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      onSourcesChange([...sources, source]);\n    }\n    setShowAddModal(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleAddTextSource = (newSource: Omit&lt;Source, \"id\"&gt;) =&gt; {\n    const source: Source = {\n      ...newSource,\n      id: &#96;text_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}&#96;, // 确保ID唯一\n      category: newSource.category || 'external', // 确保有 category\n    };\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      onSourcesChange([...sources, source]);\n    }\n    // 默认选中新添加的来源\n    if (onSelectionChange) {\n      onSelectionChange([...selectedSources, source.id]);\n    }\n    setShowTextModal(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleSelectFromKnowledgeBase = (selectedItems: any[]) =&gt; {\n    const newSources: Source[] = selectedItems.map((item) =&gt; ({\n      id: &#96;kb_${item.id}&#96;,\n      title: item.title || item.techPoint || \"未命名知识点\",\n      type: \"knowledge_base\" as const,\n      description: item.description,\n    }));\n    if (onSourcesChange) {\n      onSourcesChange([...sources, ...newSources]);\n    }\n    setShowKnowledgeBrowser(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleNavigate = (path: string) =&gt;\n;\n;",

sourcesResult.data : [];\n      const files = sources.filter(s =&gt; s.type === 'file');\n      const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&gt; s.type === 'url' || s.type === 'text');\n\n      // 加载技术点和知识点\n      const detailsResponse = await api.get(&#96;/projects/${project.id}/details&#96;);\n      const techPoints = detailsResponse.data?.success &amp;&amp; detailsResponse.data?.data?.techPoints\n        ? detailsResponse.data.data.techPoints\n        : [];\n      const knowledgePoints = detailsResponse.data?.success &amp;&amp; detailsResponse.data?.data?.knowledgePoints\n        ? detailsResponse.data.data.knowledgePoints\n        : [];\n\n      setResources({ files, internetInfo, techPoints, knowledgePoints });\n\n      // 加载对话记录\n      const convs = await ProjectConversationService.getProjectConversations(project.id);\n      setConversations(convs);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载数据失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const toggleSection = (section: string) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const DialogueContent: React.FC&lt;DialogueContentProps&gt; = \nconst handleSend = async \n\n\n      if (response.userMessage &amp;&amp; response.aiMessage) {\n        // 合并消息并去重（按消息ID）\n        const messageMap = new Map&lt;string, Message&gt;();\n        // 先添加现有消息\n        messages.forEach((msg) =&gt; {\n          messageMap.set(msg.id, msg);\n        });\n        // 再添加新消息（会覆盖重复的）\n        messageMap.set(response.userMessage.id, response.userMessage);\n        messageMap.set(response.aiMessage.id, response.aiMessage);\n        // 按时间排序\n        const newMessages = Array.from(messageMap.values()).sort((a, b) =&gt; {\n          const timeA = a.createdAt instanceof Date ? a.createdAt.getTime() : new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();\n          const timeB = b.createdAt instanceof Date ? b.createdAt.getTime() : new Date(b.createdAt).getTime();\n          return timeA - timeB; // 升序排列，最早的在前\n        });\n        setMessages(newMessages);\n\n        // 标记新增来源已发送，避免重复发送\n        if (newSourceIds.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; onSourcesSent) {\n          onSourcesSent(newSourceIds);\n        }\n\n        if (onMessageSent) {\n          onMessageSent(response.aiMessage);\n        }\n      } else if (response.userMessage) {\n        // 合并消息并去重\n        const messageMap = new Map&lt;string, Message&gt;();\n        messages.forEach((msg) =&gt; {\n          messageMap.set(msg.id, msg);\n        });\n        messageMap.set(response.userMessage.id, response.userMessage);\n        // 按时间排序\n        const newMessages = Array.from(messageMap.values()).sort((a, b) =&gt; {\n          const timeA = a.createdAt instanceof Date ?         "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 根据项目ID和分类获取来源信息列表\n   */\n  async findByProjectIdAndCategory(projectId: number, category: string): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT si.* FROM source_information si\n      INNER JOIN project_source_informations psi ON si.id = psi.source_information_id\n      WHERE psi.project_id = ? \n        AND si.status = 'active'\n        AND json_extract(si.metadata, '$.category') = ?\n      ORDER BY si.created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, [projectId, category]);\n    const rows = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result];\n    return rows.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as SourceInformation[];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建项目-来源关联\n   */\n  async createProjectAssociation(projectId: number, sourceInformationId: number, notes?: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 来源信息表\n-- 用于存储通过 SourceSidebar 添加的信息（包括文本来源和外部来源）\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_information (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COMMENT '来源唯一标识（前端生成的ID）',\n    title TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '来源标题',\n    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('knowledge_base', 'external')) COMMENT '来源类型：knowledge_base=知识库，external=外部来源',\n    url TEXT COMMENT '外部来源URL（仅external类型）',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '来源描述/内容',\n    page_type TEXT COMMENT '页面类型：tech-package, press-release, tech-strategy, tech-article',\n    conversation_id TEXT COMMENT '关联的对话ID',\n    metadata TEXT COMMENT '元数据（JSON格式）',\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')) COMMENT '状态',\n    created_by TEXT COMMENT '创建人',\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_source_id ON source_information(source_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_type ON source_information(type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_page_type ON source_information(page_type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_conversation_id ON source_information(conversation_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_status ON source_information(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_created_at ON source_information(created_at);",

        "contents": "// 获取来源信息列表（必须在参数路由之前）\nrouter.get('/', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const page = parseInt(req.query.page as string) || 1;\n    const pageSize = parseInt(req.query.pageSize as string) || 20;\n    const orderBy = req.query.orderBy as string || 'created_at';\n    const orderDirection = (req.query.orderDirection as string || 'DESC').toUpperCase();\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string;\n    const conversationId = req.query.conversationId as string;\n    const type = req.query.type as string;\n    const status = req.query.status as string || 'active';\n    const projectId = req.query.projectId ? parseInt(req.query.projectId as string) : undefined;\n\n    // 如果提供了 projectId，使用项目级查询\n    if (projectId) {\n      const sourceInformationList = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationByProjectId(projectId);\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: sourceInformationList,\n        pagination: {\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: sourceInformationList.length,\n          total: sourceInformationList.length,\n          totalPages: 1\n        }\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const where: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n    if (pageType) where.page_type = pageType;\n    if (conversationId) where.conversation_id = conversationId;\n    if (type) where.type = type;\n    if (status) where.status = status;\n\n    const options = {\n      limit: pageSize,\n      offset: (page - 1) * pageSize,\n      orderBy,\n      orderDirection: orderDirection as 'ASC' | 'DESC',\n      where: Object.keys(where).length &gt; 0 ? where : undefined\n    };\n\n    const result = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationList(options);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: result.data,\n      pagination: {\n        page: result.page,\n        pageSize: result.pageSize,\n        total: result.total,\n        totalPages: result.totalPages\n      }\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取来源信息列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async createSourceInformation(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    // 检查source_id是否已存在（只检查活跃状态的记录）\n    const existing = await this.model.findBySourceId(data.source_id);\n    if (existing &amp;&amp; existing.status === 'active') {\n      // 如果已存在且是活跃状态，更新而不是创建\n      const updated = await this.model.updateBySourceId(data.source_id, data);\n      if (!updated) {\n        throw new Error('更新来源信息失败');\n      }\n      \n      // 如果提供了 project_id，确保关联存在\n      if (data.project_id &amp;&amp; updated.id) {\n        await this.model.createProjectAssociation(data.project_id, updated.id);\n      }\n      \n      return updated;\n    }\n    \n    // 如果记录不存在或者是已删除状态，创建新记录\n    // 如果已删除的记录存在，先物理删除它，然后创建新记录\n    if (existing &amp;&amp; existing.status === 'deleted') {\n      // 物理删除已删除的记录，避免重复\n      await this.model.hardDelete(existing.id);\n    }\n    \n    const created = await this.model.create(data);\n    \n    // 如果提供了 project_id，创建项目关联\n    if (data.project_id &amp;&amp; created.id) {\n      await this.model.createProjectAssociation(data.project_id, created.id);\n    }\n    \n    return created;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取来源信息\n   */\n  async getSourceInformationById(id: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建来源信息\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateSourceInformationDTO): Promise&lt;SourceInformation&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO source_information (\n        source_id, title, type, url, description, page_type, \n        conversation_id, project_id, metadata, status, created_by\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      data.source_id,\n      data.title,\n      data.type,\n      data.url || null,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.page_type || null,\n      data.conversation_id || null,\n      data.project_id || null,\n      data.metadata ? JSON.stringify(data.metadata) : null,\n      data.status || 'active',\n      data.created_by || null\n    ];\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const id = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n    \n    const sourceInfo = await this.findById(id);\n    if (!sourceInfo) {\n      throw new Error('Failed to create source information');\n    }\n    \n    return sourceInfo;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取来源信息\n   */\n  async findById(id: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation | null&gt; {\n    const sql = 'SELECT * FROM source_information WHERE id = ?';\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./backend/src/models/SourceInformation.ts",

            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\nasync findByPageType(pageType: string): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据项目ID获取来源信息列表\n   * 支持三种方式：\n   * 1. 通过 project_id 字段查询（主要方式）\n   * 2. 通过关联表 project_source_informations 查询（补充方式）\n   * 3. 通过 page_type = 'project-{projectId}' 查询（兼容旧数据）\n   */\n  async findByProjectId(projectId: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n    const pageType = &#96;project-${projectId}&#96;;\n    const results: SourceInformation[] = [];\n    const seenIds = new Set&lt;number&gt;();\n    \n    try {\n      // 方式1: 通过 project_id 字段查询\n      try {\n        const sql1 = &#96;\n          SELECT * FROM source_information\n          WHERE project_id = ? AND status = 'active'\n          ORDER BY created_at DESC\n        &#96;;\n        const result1 = await this.db.query(sql1, [projectId]);\n        const rows1 = Array.isArray(result1) ? result1 : [result1];\n        for (const row of rows1) {\n          const parsed = this.parseJsonFields(row) as SourceInformation;\n          if (parsed.id &amp;&amp; !seenIds.has(parsed.id)) {\n            results.push(parsed);\n            seenIds.add(parsed.id);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果 project_id 字段不存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('no such column: project_id') &amp;&amp; \n            !error?.message?.includes('column \"project_id\" does not exist')) {\n          console.warn('查询 project_id 字段失败:', error?.message);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 方式2: 通过关联表查询\n      try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// 创建来源信息\nrouter.post('/', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const data: CreateSourceInformationDTO = req.body;\n    \n    // 验证必填字段\n    if (!data.source_id || !data.title || !data.type) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: 'source_id、title和type为必填字段'\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 验证type字段\n    if (!['knowledge_base', 'external'].includes(data.type)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: 'type必须是knowledge_base或external'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const sourceInformation = await sourceInformationService.createSourceInformation(data);\n    \n    res.status(201).json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformation,\n      message: '来源信息创建成功'\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('创建来源信息失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '创建来源信息失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 批量创建来源信息\nrouter.post",

      "codeBlock": {

        },
        "contents": "-- 来源信息项目关联迁移脚本\n-- 创建日期: 2025-01-XX\n-- 说明: 将来源信息从 page_type 维度迁移到项目维度\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 1. 添加 project_id 字段到 source_information 表\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 检查并添加 project_id 字段（SQLite 不支持 IF NOT EXISTS，需要先检查）\n-- 如果字段已存在，此操作会失败，需要在应用层处理\n\n-- 添加 project_id 字段\nALTER TABLE source_information ADD COLUMN project_id INTEGER;\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_information_project_id ON source_information(project_id);\n\n-- 添加外键约束（SQLite 3.37.0+ 支持，旧版本可能需要重建表）\n-- 注意：SQLite 的 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN 不支持直接添加外键\n-- 如果需要外键约束，需要重建表，这里先添加字段，外键约束在应用层处理\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 2. 从 page_type 中提取项目 ID 并更新 project_id\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 更新 project_id：从 page_type 中提取项目ID\n-- 格式: tech-package-project-123, tech-strategy-project-456 等\nUPDATE source_information\nSET project_id = CAST(\n  SUBSTR(\n    page_type,\n    INSTR(page_type, 'project-') + 8\n  ) AS INTEGER\n)\nWHERE page_type LIKE '%-project-%'\n  AND project_id IS NULL;\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 3. 清理 page_type 字段，保留标准格式\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 将 tech-package-project-123 格式转换为 tech-package\nUPDATE source_information\nSET page_type = SUBSTR(page_type, 1, INSTR(page_type, '-project-') - 1)\nWHERE page_type LIKE '%-project-%'\n  AND INSTR(page_type, '-project-') &gt; 0;\n\n-- 将 tech-strategy-project-123 格式转换为 tech-strategy\n-- 注意：上面的 UPDATE 已经处理了所有 -project- 的情况\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 4. 在 project_source_informations 表中建立关联\n-- ==============================================",

        "contents": "// 根据页面类型获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get('/page-type/:pageType', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 确保表已初始化\n    try {\n      await sourceInformationService.initializeTable();\n    } catch (initError: any) {\n      // 如果表已存在，忽略错误\n      if (!initError?.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; \n          !initError?.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('初始化表时出现警告，继续执行:', initError?.message);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const { pageType } = req.params;\n\n    const sourceInformationList = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationByPageType(pageType);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformationList\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取页面类型来源信息列表失败:', error);\n    console.error('错误详情:', error instanceof Error ? error.stack : error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取页面类型来源信息列表失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据source_id获取来源信息（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有来源信息\n   */\n  async findAll(options: QueryOptions = {}): Promise&lt;PaginatedResult&lt;SourceInformation&gt;&gt; {\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM source_information';\n    const values: any[] = [];\n    const conditions: string[] = [];\n\n    // 添加WHERE条件\n    if (options.where) {\n      Object.entries(options.where).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n        conditions.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n        values.push(value);\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n      sql += ' WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n    }\n\n    // 添加排序\n    if (options.orderBy) {\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY ${options.orderBy} ${options.orderDirection || 'ASC'}&#96;;\n    } else {\n      sql += ' ORDER BY created_at DESC';\n    }\n\n    // 获取总数\n    const countSql = sql.replace('SELECT *', 'SELECT COUNT(*) as count');\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, values);\n    const total = Array.isArray(countResult) ? countResult[0].count : countResult.count;\n\n    // 添加分页\n    if (options.limit) {\n      sql += &#96; LIMIT ${options.limit}&#96;;\n      if (options.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ${options.offset}&#96;;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    const rows = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result];\n    const data = rows.map((row: any) =&gt; this.parseJsonFields(row)) as SourceInformation[];\n    \n    const pageSize = options.limit || total;\n    const page = options.offset ? Math.floor(options.offset / pageSize) + 1 : 1;\n    \n    return {\n      data,\n      total,\n      page,\n      pageSize,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize)\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据对话ID获取来源信息列表\n   */\n  async findByConversationId(conversationId: string): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\nasync findByProjectId(projectId: number): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 方式2: 通过关联表查询\n      try {\n        const sql2 = &#96;\n          SELECT si.* FROM source_information si\n          INNER JOIN project_source_informations psi ON si.id = psi.source_information_id\n          WHERE psi.project_id = ? AND si.status = 'active'\n          ORDER BY si.created_at DESC\n        &#96;;\n        const result2 = await this.db.query(sql2, [projectId]);\n        const rows2 = Array.isArray(result2) ? result2 : [result2];\n        for (const row of rows2) {\n          const parsed = this.parseJsonFields(row) as SourceInformation;\n          if (parsed.id &amp;&amp; !seenIds.has(parsed.id)) {\n            results.push(parsed);\n            seenIds.add(parsed.id);\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果关联表不存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('no such table: project_source_informations') &amp;&amp;\n            !error?.message?.includes('relation \"project_source_informations\" does not exist')) {\n          console.warn('查询关联表失败:', error?.message);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 方式3: 通过 page_type 查询（兼容旧数据）\n      try {\n        const sql3 = &#96;\n          SELECT * FROM source_information\n          WHERE page_type = ?         "contents": "// 根据项目ID获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get('/project/:projectId', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 确保表已初始化\n    try {\n      await sourceInformationService.initializeTable();\n    } catch (initError: any) {\n      // 如果表已存在，忽略错误\n      if (!initError?.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; \n          !initError?.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('初始化表时出现警告，继续执行:', initError?.message);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const projectId = parseInt(req.params.projectId);\n    \n    if (isNaN(projectId)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '无效的项目ID'\n      });\n    }\n\n    const sourceInformationList = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationByProjectId(projectId);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformationList\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取项目来源信息列表失败:', error);\n    console.error('错误详情:', error instanceof Error ? error.stack : error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取项目来源信息列表失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据页面类型获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get",

        "contents": "export class SourceInformationModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 根据对话ID获取来源信息列表\n   */\n  async findByConversationId(conversationId: string): Promise&lt;SourceInformation[]&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM source_information \n      WHERE conversation_id = ?         "contents": "export class TechArticleAggregationService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 收集来源数据\n   */\n  private async collectSourceData(\n    conversationIds: string[],\n    outputIds: string[]\n  ): Promise&lt;{\n    conversations: Array&lt;{\n      id: string;\n      pageType: string;\n      title: string;\n      messages: Array&lt;{ role: string; content: string }&gt;;\n      summary: string;\n    }&gt;;\n    outputs: Array&lt;{\n      id: string;\n      pageType: string;\n      title: string;\n      content: any;\n      summary: string;\n    }&gt;;\n    references: SourceReference[];\n  }&gt; {\n    const conversations: any[] = [];\n    const outputs: any[] = [];\n    const references: SourceReference[] = [];\n\n    // 收集对话数据\n    for (const convId of conversationIds) {\n      try {\n        const conversation = await this.aiSearchService.getConversation(convId);\n        if (!conversation) {\n          logger.warn('对话不存在，跳过', { conversationId: convId });\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        const pageType = conversation.page_type || 'unknown';\n        const messages = (conversation.messages || []).map((m: any) =&gt; ({\n          role: m.role,\n          content: m.content,\n        }));\n\n        // 生成摘要（取第一条用户消息的前200字）\n        const firstUserMessage = messages.find((m: any) =&gt; m.role === 'user');\n        const summary = firstUserMessage\n          ? firstUserMessage.content.substring(0, 200) + (firstUserMessage.content.length &gt; 200 ? '...' : '')\n          : '';\n\n        conversations.push({\n          id: convId,\n          pageType,\n          title: conversation.title,\n          messages,\n          summary,\n        });\n\n        references.push({\n          type: 'conversation',\n          id: convId,\n          pageType,\n          title: conversation.title,\n          summary,\n        });\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.error('获取对话失败', { conversationId: convId, error });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 收集输出数据\n    for (const outputId of outputIds)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// 根据对话ID获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get('/conversation/:conversationId', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 确保表已初始化\n    try {\n      await sourceInformationService.initializeTable();\n    } catch (initError: any) {\n      // 如果表已存在，忽略错误\n      if (!initError?.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; \n          !initError?.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('初始化表时出现警告，继续执行:', initError?.message);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const { conversationId } = req.params;\n\n    const sourceInformationList = await sourceInformationService.getSourceInformationByConversationId(conversationId);\n    \n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: sourceInformationList\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('获取对话来源信息列表失败:', error);\n    console.error('错误详情:', error instanceof Error ? error.stack : error);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      success: false,\n      message: '获取对话来源信息列表失败',\n      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    });\n  }\n});\n\n// 根据项目ID获取来源信息列表（必须在 /:id 之前）\nrouter.get",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadConversationDetail = \nasync (\n      conversationId: string,\n      options?: {\n        append?: boolean;\n        before?: string;\n      }\n    ) =&gt; {\n\n            \n            // 合并所有来源：现有来源 + 数据库来源（优先）+ 对话来源（仅当不在数据库中时）\n            setSources(prev =&gt; {\n              const sourceMap = new Map&lt;string, Source&gt;();\n              \n              // 1. 先添加现有的来源（包括页面类型的来源）\n              prev.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              // 2. 添加数据库中的来源（优先，因为已经过滤了已删除的记录）\n              dbSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n              \n              // 3. 添加对话中的来源（仅当不在数据库中时，避免重新添加已删除的来源）\n              conversationSources.forEach(s =&gt; {\n                // 如果来源不在数据库中，说明可能已被删除，不添加\n                // 如果来源在数据库中，说明是活跃的，已经在步骤2中添加了\n                if (!dbSourceIds.has(s.id)) {\n                  // 不在数据库中，可能是已删除的来源，不添加\n                  console.log('[SourceInfo] 跳过对话中的已删除来源:', s.id, s.title);\n                }\n              });\n              \n              const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\n              console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length, {\n                prev: prev.length,\n                conversation: conversationSources.length,\n                db: dbSources.length,\n                filtered: conversationSources.filter(s =&gt; !dbSourceIds.has(s.id)).length\n              });\n              return merged;\n            });\n          } catch (error) {\n            console.error(\"[SourceInfo] 加载对话来源信息失败:\", error);\n            // 如果加载失败，不添加对话中的来源，因为可能包含已删除的来源\n    }\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const handleCreateConversation = useCallback(async (): Promise&lt;Conversation | null&gt; =&gt; {\n    try {\n      clearGlobalError();\n      \n      // 如果已有当前对话，直接返回，避免重复创建\n      if (currentConversation) {\n        console.log('[ConversationDebug] 已有当前对话，跳过创建:', currentConversation.id);\n        return currentConversation;\n      }\n      \n      const selectedSources = sources.filter((s) =&gt; selectedSourceIds.includes(s.id));\n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 创建新对话，来源数量:', selectedSources.length);\n\n      const conversationRequest: any = {\n        title: &#96;对话 ${new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN', { year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }).replace(/\\//g, '/')}&#96;,\n        sources: selectedSources,\n        pageType: effectivePageType, // 使用包含项目ID的 pageType\n      };\n      \n      // 如果提供了projectId，添加到请求中\n      if (projectId) {\n        const projectIdNum = parseInt(projectId);\n        if (!isNaN(projectIdNum)) {\n          conversationRequest.projectId = projectIdNum;\n        }\n      }\n      \n      const conversation = await aiSearchService.createConversation(conversationRequest);\n\n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 新对话已创建:', conversation.id);\n\n      if (selectedWorkflowId) {\n        persistWorkflowSelection(selectedWorkflowId, conversation.id);\n      }\n      await loadConversations({ activeConversationId: conversation.id });\n      return conversation;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"创建对话失败:\", error);\n      reportError(\"创建对话失败，请稍后重试\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }, [\n    clearGlobalError,\n    sources,\n    selectedSourceIds,\n    reportError,\n    selectedWorkflowId,\n    persistWorkflowSelection,\n    loadConversations,\n    currentConversation,\n    effectivePageType,\n  ]);\n\n  const handleCreateNewConversation = useCallback\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst summarizeAndSaveConversationForNavigation = async (targetPageType: 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&lt;string | null&gt; =&gt; {\n\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      // 构建对话文本\n      const conversationText = currentConversation.messages.map((msg) =&gt; {\n        const role = msg.role === 'user' ? '用户' : 'AI助手';\n        return &#96;${role}: ${msg.content}&#96;;\n      }).join('\\n\\n');\n\n      // 如果对话文本太长，先截断（保留前2000字符）\n      const maxLength = 2000;\n      const truncatedText = conversationText.length &gt; maxLength \n        ? conversationText.substring(0, maxLength) + '\\n\\n...（内容已截断）'\n        : conversationText;\n\n      // 生成总结标题和描述\n      let summaryTitle = '技术包装对话摘要';\n      let summaryDescription = truncatedText;\n\n      // 尝试从最后一条AI消息中提取关键信息作为标题\n      const lastAssistantMessage = [...currentConversation.messages]\n        .reverse()\n        .find((m) =&gt; m.role === 'assistant');\n      \n      if (lastAssistantMessage &amp;&amp; lastAssistantMessage.content) {\n        // 取前100字符作为标题候选\n        const contentPreview = lastAssistantMessage.content.substring(0, 100).replace(/\\n/g, ' ').trim();\n        if (contentPreview.length &gt; 10) {\n          summaryTitle = contentPreview.length &gt; 50 \n            ? contentPreview.substring(0, 50) + '...'\n            : contentPreview;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 创建来源信息\n      // 根据当前页面的 pageType 设置类别，而不是目标页面\n      // 因为对话是在当前页面产生的\n      const sourceId = &#96;tech_package_conversation_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}&#96;;\n      let category: SourceCategory = 'external';\n      \n      if (config.pageType === 'tech-package') {\n        category = 'tech-package-qa';\n      } else if (config.pageType === 'tech-strategy') {\n        category = 'tech-strategy-qa';\n      } else if (config.pageType === 'tech-article') {\n        category = 'tech-article-qa';\n      }\n      \n      const source: Source = {\n        id: sourceId,\n        title: summaryTitle\n,\n      };\n  };\n;",

根据代码分析，AI问答助手对来源信息的处理机制如下：

## AI问答助手来源信息处理机制

### 1. 来源信息分类

`SourceSidebar` 组件将来源信息分为三大类：

| 分组 | 类别 (category) | 说明 |
|------|----------------|------|
| **AI共创信息** | `ai-qa-summary` | AI问答总结 |
| | `tech-package-qa` | 技术包装问答 |
| | `tech-strategy-qa` | 技术策略问答 |
| | `tech-article-qa` | 技术通稿问答 |
| **技术资源** | `technical-translation` | 技术转译内容 |
| **外部来源** | `external` 或其他 | 用户添加的文本/文件/网页等 |

### 2. 来源类型区分

来源信息有两种基础类型 (`type`)：
- **`knowledge_base`** - 知识库来源（项目内部资源）
- **`external`** - 外部来源（文件、网页、用户输入文本）

### 3. 发送消息时的处理逻辑

```221:241:frontend/src/components/ai-search/DialogueContent.tsx
      // 计算新增的来源（当前选中但尚未发送过的）
      const newSources = sources.filter((s) => !sentSourceIds.includes(s.id));
      const newSourceIds = newSources.map((s) => s.id);
      
      // 构建文件列表和知识库名称（仅针对新增的来源）
      let fileList: string | undefined;
      let knowledgeBaseNames: string | undefined;
      
      if (newSources.length > 0) {
        // 筛选新增的文件（type === 'external'）
        const fileSources = newSources.filter((s) => s.type === 'external');
        if (fileSources.length > 0) {
          fileList = fileSources.map((s) => s.title).join(', ');
        }
        
        // 筛选新增的知识库（type === 'knowledge_base'）
        const knowledgeBaseSources = newSources.filter((s) => s.type === 'knowledge_base');
        if (knowledgeBaseSources.length > 0) {
          knowledgeBaseNames = knowledgeBaseSources.map((s) => s.title).join(', ');
        }
      }
```

关键处理流程：

1. **去重机制** - 只发送"新增的来源"（当前选中但尚未发送过的），避免重复传递
2. **类型分离** - 将来源按 `type` 分为：
   - `external` → 生成 `fileList`（文件列表字符串）
   - `knowledge_base` → 生成 `knowledgeBaseNames`（知识库名称字符串）
3. **传递给后端** - 通过 `aiSearchService.sendMessage()` 将来源信息、文件列表、知识库名称一并发送给AI

### 4. 数据存储结构

后端 `source_information` 表存储：
- `source_id` - 唯一标识
- `title` - 来源标题
- `type` - 来源类型
- `description` - 内容描述
- `metadata.category` - 分类标签（用于前端分组显示）
- `project_id` - 关联项目

### 5. 来源选择与勾选

用户在侧边栏勾选来源后，只有被选中的来源会在发送消息时传递给AI。系统通过 `selectedSourceIds` 和 `sentSourceIds` 两个状态来管理选择和已发送状态。

        "contents": "/**\n * 发送消息\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages\n */\nrouter.post(\n  '/conversations/:id/messages',\n  ensureTablesInitialized,\n  upload.array('files', 10),\n  async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const { id } = req.params;\n      let sourcesValue = req.body.sources;\n      if (typeof sourcesValue === 'string') {\n        try {\n          sourcesValue = JSON.parse(sourcesValue);\n        } catch (parseError) {\n          logger.warn('解析sources失败，使用原始值', { parseError });\n          sourcesValue = undefined;\n        }\n      }\n\n      const body = {\n        content: req.body.content,\n        sources: Array.isArray(sourcesValue) ? sourcesValue : undefined,\n        contextWindowSize: req.body.contextWindowSize,\n        workflowId: req.body.workflowId,\n        fileList: req.body.fileList,\n        knowledgeBaseNames: req.body.knowledgeBaseNames,\n      };\n      const files = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\n\n      const dto = validateDTO(SendMessageSchema, body);\n      const result = await sendMessageUseCase.execute({\n        conversationId: id,\n        content: dto.content,\n        sources: dto.sources,\n        files,\n        contextWindowSize: typeof dto.contextWindowSize === 'number' ? dto.contextWindowSize : (dto.contextWindowSize ? parseInt(String(dto.contextWindowSize), 10) : undefined),\n        workflowId: dto.workflowId,\n        fileList: dto.fileList,\n        knowledgeBaseNames: dto.knowledgeBaseNames,\n      });\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return res.status(500).json(\n          formatApiResponse(false, null, '发送消息失败', result.error.message)\n        );\n      }\n\n      res.json(\n        formatApiResponse(\n          true,\n          result.value,\n          result.value.error ? source.description.trim()) {\n          const title = source.title || '附加信息';\n          textContents.push(&#96;【${title}】\\n${source.description.trim()}&#96;);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n    \n    // 文件的markdown内容总是添加（无论是否第一次对话）\n    if (fileMarkdownContents.length &gt; 0) {\n      textContents.push(...fileMarkdownContents);\n    }\n    \n    if (textContents.length &gt; 0) {\n      additionalContext = '\\n\\n=== 附加信息（文件内容） ===\\n' + textContents.join('\\n\\n---\\n\\n');\n      logger.info('提取附加信息（外部来源和文件markdown）', {\n        isFirstMessage,\n        filesCount: fileMarkdownContents.length,\n        totalTextLength: additionalContext.length,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 将附加信息合并到 query 中\n    // 文件的markdown内容总是添加，外部来源的文本内容仅在第一次对话时添加\n    let finalQuery = params.content;\n    if (additionalContext) {\n      finalQuery = params.content + additionalContext;\n      logger.info('合并附加信息到查询内容', {\n        isFirstMessage,\n        originalLength: params.content.length,\n        additionalLength: additionalContext.length,\n        finalLength: finalQuery.length,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 检查上一条消息是否是子Agent（工具箱）生成的内容\n    // 主Agent和子Agent交叉对话的逻辑：\n    // 1. 主对话使用同一个 dify_conversation_id 保持多轮对话\n    // 2. 子Agent（五看、三定等）处理上下文窗口内容，生成分析结果\n    // 3. 当用户继续主对话时，如果上一条是子Agent的输出，则将其作为上下文传递给主Agent\n    let toolOutputContext = '';\n    if (!isFirstMessage &amp;&amp;         "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\nconst \n;\n\n        // 确保 extractedOutput.content 也是字符串（用于保存到 outputs 字段）\n        const cleanExtractedOutput = {\n          ...extractedOutput,\n          content: aiContent, // 使用提取的字符串内容\n          metadata: {\n            ...(extractedOutput.metadata || {}),\n            ...(toolCallsHistory ? { toolCalls: toolCallsHistory } : {})\n          }\n        };\n\n        // 记录保存的消息内容\n        logger.info('保存AI消息', {\n          workflowId: finalWorkflowId,\n          content: aiContent,\n          contentLength: aiContent.length,\n          outputsContent: cleanExtractedOutput.content,\n          outputsKeys: Object.keys(cleanExtractedOutput),\n        });\n\n        const aiMessageRecord = await this.aiSearchService.sendMessage(\n          params.conversationId,\n          'assistant',\n          aiContent,\n          params.sources || [],\n          [],\n          cleanExtractedOutput\n        );\n        \n        logger.info('AI消息已保存', {\n          messageId: aiMessageRecord.id,\n          content: aiMessageRecord.content,\n          contentLength: aiMessageRecord.content?.length || 0,\n        });\n\n        return success({\n          userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n          aiMessage: formatMessageRecord(aiMessageRecord),\n        });\n      } catch (workflowError: any) {\n        logger.error('工作流执行失败', { workflowError });\n        return success({\n          userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n          error: '工作流执行失败，请稍后重试',\n          errorDetail: workflowError?.message || String(workflowError),\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('发送消息失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'SEND_MESSAGE_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '发送消息失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取功能类型的中文标签\n   */\n  private getFeatureLabel(featureType: string): string {\n    const labelMap: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n      'five-view-analysis': '五看分析'\n,\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n\n        const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, mappingConfig.inputMappings);\n\n        // 获取对话的 Dify conversation_id（如果存在），用于多轮对话\n        const difyConversationId = conversationRecord?.difyConversationId || null;\n        \n        logger.info('准备发送消息到Dify工作流', {\n          本地对话ID: params.conversationId,\n          DifyConversationId: difyConversationId || '未设置（首次对话，Dify将返回新的conversation_id）',\n        });\n        \n        // 将 Dify conversation_id 添加到 workflowInput 中，这样 Agent 节点可以获取到\n        if (difyConversationId) {\n          workflowInput.conversationId = difyConversationId;\n          logger.info('已设置Dify conversation_id到工作流输入', { difyConversationId });\n        } else {\n          logger.info('首次对话，未设置Dify conversation_id，Dify将创建新的对话');\n        }\n\n        // 判断 finalWorkflowId 是 AI 角色 ID 还是工作流 ID\n        // AI 角色 ID 可能以 'role_' 或 'ai-role-' 开头\n        const isRoleId = finalWorkflowId.startsWith('role_') || finalWorkflowId.startsWith('ai-role-');\n        \n        let workflowResult;\n        if (isRoleId) {\n          // 直接调用 AI 角色\n          logger.info('检测到 AI 角色 ID，直接调用角色', { roleId: finalWorkflowId });\n          workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeRole(finalWorkflowId, {\n            input: workflowInput,\n          });\n        } else {\n          // 通过工作流调用\n          logger.info('检测到工作流 ID，通过工作流调用', { workflowId: finalWorkflowId });\n          workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(finalWorkflowId, {\n            input: workflowInput,\n          });\n        }\n\n        // 检查执行结果\n        if\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\n\n\n  async execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const userMessageRecord = await this.aiSearchService.sendMessage(\n        params.conversationId,\n        'user',\n        params.content,\n        params.sources || [],\n        params.files || []\n      );\n\n      const conversationRecord = await this.aiSearchService.getConversation(params.conversationId);\n\n      try {\n        const requestedWorkflowId = params.workflowId;\n        const finalWorkflowId = requestedWorkflowId || await resolveWorkflowId();\n\n        if (!finalWorkflowId) {\n          return success({\n            userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n            error: '未找到可用的工作流配置',\n          });\n        }\n\n        const mappingConfig = await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, finalWorkflowId);\n\n        if (!mappingConfig) {\n          const message =\n            requestedWorkflowId &amp;&amp; requestedWorkflowId === finalWorkflowId\n              ? &#96;所选工作流(${finalWorkflowId})尚未配置字段映射&#96;\n              : '尚未配置字段映射，请先完成字段映射配置';\n          return success({\n            userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n            error: message,\n            errorDetail: '请在字段映射配置中为该工作流完成输入输出映射',\n          });\n        }\n\n        const conversationData = await this.buildConversationData({\n          conversation: conversationRecord,\n          content: params.content,\n          sources: params.sources,\n          files: params.files,\n          contextWindowSize: params.contextWindowSize,\n          workflowId: finalWorkflowId,\n          fileList: params.fileList,\n          knowledgeBaseNames: params.knowledgeBaseNames,\n        });\n        const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, mappingConfig.inputMappings);\n\n        // 获取对话的 Dify conversation_id（如果存在），用于多轮对话\n        const difyConversationId = conversationRecord?.difyConversationId || null;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// Dify聊天消息代理\nrouter.post('/chat-messages', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    console.log('=== Dify Chat Messages Proxy ===');\n    console.log('Request body:', req.body);\n    \n    const { appType, apiKey: clientApiKey, ...requestBody } = req.body;\n    const apiKey = getApiKey(appType) || clientApiKey;\n\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      console.error('API key is missing for appType:', appType);\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'API key is required' });\n    }\n\n    console.log('Using API key for appType:', appType);\n    console.log('API Key (first 10 chars):', apiKey.substring(0, 10) + '...');\n    \n    // 直接使用Dify后端地址（9999端口）\n    const difyBaseUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1';\n    console.log('Dify base URL:', difyBaseUrl);\n\n    // 清理requestBody，确保只发送Dify需要的字段\n    const { appType: _, ...cleanedBody } = requestBody;\n    \n    console.log('发送给Dify的请求体:', {\n      query: cleanedBody.query,\n      inputs: cleanedBody.inputs,\n      conversation_id: cleanedBody.conversation_id,\n      response_mode: 'blocking'\n    });\n\n    // 正确的Dify API端点\n    const difyApiUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/chat-messages';\n    console.log('请求Dify API URL:', difyApiUrl);\n    \n    // 构建请求体，只在有有效conversation_id时才包含它\n    const requestPayload: any = {\n      query: cleanedBody.query,\n      inputs: cleanedBody.inputs || {},\n      user: requestBody.user || &#96;user-${Date.now()}&#96;, \n      response_mode: 'blocking'\n    };\n    \n    // 只在有有效conversation_id时才添加它\n    if (cleanedBody.conversation_id &amp;&amp; cleanedBody.conversation_id.trim() !== '') {\n      requestPayload.conversation_id = cleanedBody.conversation_id;\n    }\n    \n    console.log('最终发送给Dify的请求体:', requestPayload);\n    \n    const difyResponse = await axios.post\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export const mapWorkflowInput = (\n  data: any,\n  inputMappings?: any[]\n) =&gt; {\n  if (inputMappings &amp;&amp; inputMappings.length &gt; 0) {\n    const mapped = fieldMappingEngine.mapInputFields(data, inputMappings);\n    \n    // 确保关键字段始终被保留（即使映射配置中没有配置）\n    // 这些字段对于附件传递至关重要\n    if (data.sources &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(data.sources)) {\n      mapped.sources = data.sources;\n      logger.info('mapWorkflowInput: 保留 sources 字段', {\n        sourcesCount: data.sources.length,\n        sources: data.sources.map((s: any) =&gt; ({\n          id: s.id,\n          title: s.title,\n          type: s.type,\n          hasUrl: !!s.url,\n          url: s.url,\n        })),\n      });\n    }\n    if (data.files &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(data.files)) {\n      mapped.files = data.files;\n      logger.info('mapWorkflowInput: 保留 files 字段', {\n        filesCount: data.files.length,\n      });\n    }\n    if (data.fileList &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(data.fileList)) {\n      mapped.fileList = data.fileList;\n      logger.info('mapWorkflowInput: 保留 fileList 字段', {\n        fileListCount: data.fileList.length,\n      });\n    }\n    \n    // 确保 query 字段存在（即使映射配置中没有）\n    if (!mapped.query &amp;&amp; data.query) {\n      mapped.query = data.query;\n    }\n    \n    logger.info('mapWorkflowInput: 映射完成', {\n      hasInputMappings: true,\n      mappedKeys: Object.keys(mapped),\n      hasSources: !!mapped.sources,\n      sourcesCount: Array.isArray(mapped.sources) ? mapped.sources.length : 0,\n      hasFiles: !!mapped.files,\n      filesCount: Array.isArray(mapped.files) ? mapped.files.length : 0,\n      hasFileList: !!mapped.fileList,\n      fileListCount: Array.isArray(mapped.fileList) ? mapped.fileList.length : 0,\n    });\n    \n    return mapped;\n  }\n  // 如果没有映射配置，直接返回数据，但确保 query 字段存在\n  const result = { ...data };\n  if (!result.query &amp;&amp; data.query) {\n    result.query = data.query;\n  }\n  \n  logger.info\n\n;",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\nasync execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      const messageOutputs = {\n        ...extractedOutput,\n        metadata: {\n          ...(extractedOutput.metadata || {}),\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\n          workflowId: targetWorkflowId,\n          sourceMessageId: dto.messageId || null,\n          executionId: (workflowResult as any).executionId || null,\n          triggeredAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n          workflowInput,\n          baseContent: conversationQuery,\n          context: {\n            historySize: conversationData.history?.length || 0,\n            historyLimit: conversationData.historyLimit,\n            summary: conversationData.summary,\n            keyPhrases: conversationData.keyPhrases,\n          },\n        },\n      };\n\n      const aiMessage = await this.aiSearchService.sendMessage(\n        conversationId,\n        'assistant',\n        aiContent,\n        targetSources,\n        [],\n        messageOutputs\n      );\n\n      return success({\n        message: formatMessageRecord(aiMessage),\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('子Agent执行失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'TRIGGER_AGENT_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '子Agent执行失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async resolveBaseContent(conversation: any, dto: TriggerAgentDTO) {\n    \n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n    if (params.files &amp;&amp; params.files.length &gt; 0) {\n      try {\n        // 通过文件名查找文件记录，获取markdown内容\n        for (const file of params.files) {\n          try {\n            // 通过原始文件名查找文件记录\n            const allFiles = await fileService.getAllFiles({\n              status: 'active',\n            });\n            const fileRecord = allFiles.find(\n              (f) =&gt; f.original_name === file.originalname || f.stored_name === file.filename\n            );\n            \n            if (fileRecord &amp;&amp; fileRecord.metadata) {\n              const metadata = typeof fileRecord.metadata === 'string' \n                ? JSON.parse(fileRecord.metadata) \n                : fileRecord.metadata;\n              \n              if (metadata.markdownContent) {\n                fileMarkdownContents.push(&#96;【${fileRecord.original_name}】\\n${metadata.markdownContent}&#96;);\n                logger.info('从文件记录中提取markdown内容', {\n                  fileName: fileRecord.original_name,\n                  markdownLength: metadata.markdownContent.length,\n                });\n              }\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            logger.warn('提取文件markdown内容失败', {\n              fileName: file.originalname,\n              error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n            });\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.warn('批量提取文件markdown内容失败', {\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 判断是否是第一次对话（对话不存在或没有历史消息）\n    const isFirstMessage = !params.conversation || \n                          !params.conversation.messages || \n                          params.conversation.messages.length === 0;\n    \n    // 提取附加信息：外部来源的文本内容和文件的markdown内容\n    let additionalContext = '';\n    \n    const textContents: string[] = [];\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class DifyGateway {\n\n\n  async executeChat(input: ChatInput): Promise&lt;Result&lt;ChatOutput&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await this.retry(() =&gt;\n        this.chatClient.post('/chat-messages', {\n          query: input.query,\n          conversation_id: input.conversationId,\n          inputs: input.inputs ?? {},\n          response_mode: 'blocking',\n          user: input.userId ?? 'todify-user',\n          files: [],\n        })\n      );\n\n      return success({\n        conversationId: response.data?.conversation_id,\n        messageId: response.data?.message_id,\n        answer: response.data?.answer,\n        raw: response.data,\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      const axiosError = error as any;\n      const errorDetails = {\n        message: axiosError.message || (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)),\n        code: axiosError.code,\n        status: axiosError.response?.status,\n        statusText: axiosError.response?.statusText,\n        responseData: axiosError.response?.data,\n        requestUrl: axiosError.config?.url,\n        requestBaseURL: axiosError.config?.baseURL,\n        fullUrl: axiosError.config?.baseURL ? &#96;${axiosError.config.baseURL}${axiosError.config.url}&#96; : axiosError.config?.url,\n        errno: axiosError.errno,\n        syscall: axiosError.syscall,\n        address: axiosError.address,\n        port: axiosError.port,\n      };\n      logger.error('Dify executeChat 失败', { error: errorDetails, input });\n      console.error('Dify executeChat 详细错误:', JSON.stringify(errorDetails, null, 2));\n      \n      // 构建详细的错误消息\n      let errorMessage = errorDetails.message;\n      if (errorDetails.code) {\n        errorMessage += &#96; (${errorDetails.code})&#96;;\n      }\n      if (errorDetails.status) {\n        errorMessage += &#96; [HTTP ${errorDetails.status}]&#96;;\n      }\n      if (errorDetails.responseData) {\n        errorMessage += &#96;: ${JSON.stringify(errorDetails.responseData)}&#96;;\n      }\n      \n      return failure({\n        code: 'DIFY_CHAT_ERROR',\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n\n        \n        // 如果还没有找到，尝试从 extractedOutput 中提取\n        const extractedOutput = extractWorkflowOutput(workflowResult, mappingConfig.outputMappings);\n        if (!newDifyConversationId &amp;&amp; extractedOutput &amp;&amp; typeof extractedOutput === 'object') {\n          const outputObj = extractedOutput as any;\n          if (outputObj.conversation_id &amp;&amp; typeof outputObj.conversation_id === 'string') {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputObj.conversation_id;\n          }\n        }\n\n        // 如果获取到了新的 conversation_id，保存到对话记录中\n        if (newDifyConversationId) {\n          await this.aiSearchService.updateDifyConversationId(params.conversationId, newDifyConversationId);\n          logger.info('✅ 已更新对话的 Dify conversation_id', {\n            本地对话ID: params.conversationId,\n            DifyConversationId: newDifyConversationId,\n            是否首次对话: !difyConversationId,\n          });\n        } else {\n          logger.warn('⚠️ 未从Dify工作流响应中提取到conversation_id', {\n            本地对话ID: params.conversationId,\n            之前是否有DifyConversationId: !!difyConversationId,\n          });\n        }\n\n        // 辅助函数：确保内容是字符串\n        const ensureStringContent = (content: any)\n;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n\n,\n        });\n        \n        // 如果提取的内容为空，尝试从工作流结果中提取\n        if (!aiContent || aiContent.trim() === '') {\n          const outputs = (workflowData?.outputs || {}) as any;\n          \n          // 按优先级尝试多个字段\n          aiContent = \n            ensureStringContent(outputs.text) ||\n            ensureStringContent(outputs.answer) ||\n            ensureStringContent(outputs.content) ||\n            ensureStringContent(outputs.output) ||\n            '';\n          \n          // 如果outputs.output是对象，尝试从中提取\n          if (!aiContent &amp;&amp; outputs.output &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.output === 'object') {\n            aiContent = \n              ensureStringContent(outputs.output.answer) ||\n              ensureStringContent(outputs.output.text) ||\n              ensureStringContent(outputs.output.content) ||\n              '';\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果还是没有内容，尝试使用 message 字段（但排除默认消息）\n        if (!aiContent || aiContent.trim() === '') {\n          const message = workflowResult?.message;\n          if (message &amp;&amp; typeof message === 'string' &amp;&amp; message.trim() &amp;&amp; message.trim() !== '工作流执行完成') {\n            aiContent = message.trim();\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 记录最终提取的内容\n        logger.info('最终提取的AI内容', {\n          workflowId: finalWorkflowId,\n          hasContent: !!aiContent,\n          contentLength: aiContent?.length || 0,\n          contentPreview: aiContent ? aiContent.substring(0, 100) : null,\n        });\n        \n        // 最后使用默认消息\n        if (!aiContent || aiContent.trim() === '') {\n          aiContent = '工作流执行完成';\n        }\n\n        // 从工作流结果中提取工具调用信息\n        const toolCallsHistory = workflowData?.metadata?.toolCallsHistory || \n                                 (workflowResult as any)?.metadata?.toolCallsHistory;\n\n        // 确保 extractedOutput.content 也是字符串（用于保存到 outputs 字段）\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 构建对话数据，包含根据contextWindowSize截取的上下文历史\n   * 此方法适用于所有工具（五看、三定、技术矩阵、传播、展具与视频、翻译等）\n   * @param conversation 对话对象\n   * @param conversationQuery 对话查询内容\n   * @param targetSources 目标来源\n   * @param dto 触发Agent的DTO，包含contextWindowSize参数\n   * @returns 包含历史上下文的对话数据\n   */\n  private buildConversationData(\n    conversation: any,\n    conversationQuery: string,\n    targetSources: any[],\n    dto: TriggerAgentDTO\n  ) {\n    const sortedMessages = [...(conversation.messages || [])];\n    // 根据contextWindowSize构建上下文（最近N条消息或全部历史）\n    // contextWindowSize: 5/10/20 表示最近N条消息，0 表示全部历史\n    const context = buildConversationContext(sortedMessages, {\n      historyLimit: dto.contextWindowSize,\n    });\n\n    // 获取最后一条助手消息和用户消息，用于字段映射\n    const lastAssistantMessage = [...sortedMessages].reverse().find((m) =&gt; m.role === 'assistant');\n    const lastUserMessage = [...sortedMessages].reverse().find((m) =&gt; m.role === 'user');\n\n    return {\n      query: conversationQuery,\n      sources: targetSources,\n      files: [],\n      history: context.history, // 根据contextWindowSize截取的历史消息\n      historyLimit: context.historyLimit,\n      historySize: context.historySize,\n      summary: context.summary,\n      keyPhrases: context.keyPhrases,\n      // 子Agent（如五看、三定等）每次调用都是独立的分析任务\n      // 不需要传递 conversationId，让 Dify 创建新的对话\n      conversationId: '',\n      featureType: dto.featureType,\n      lastAssistantMessage: lastAssistantMessage || undefined,\n      lastUserMessage: lastUserMessage || undefined,\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// Dify工作流字段映射 - 基于robot1-技术包装.yml\nexport interface DifyFieldMapping {\n  // 输入字段映射\n  inputs: {\n    // input1: 上游信息 (必填, 最大5000字符)\n    input1: {\n      type: 'paragraph';\n      required: true;\n      maxLength: 5000;\n      label: '上游信息';\n      description: '输入需要处理的上游信息内容';\n    };\n    // input2: 附件上传 (可选, 最多5个文件)\n    input2: {\n      type: 'file-list';\n      required: false;\n      maxFiles: 5;\n      allowedTypes: ['image', 'document'];\n      allowedExtensions: ['.JPG', '.JPEG', '.PNG', '.GIF', '.WEBP', '.SVG'];\n      label: '附件上传';\n      description: '支持上传图片和文档文件';\n    };\n    // input3: 优化建议 (可选, 最大1000字符)\n    input3: {\n      type: 'paragraph';\n      required: false;\n      maxLength: 1000;\n      label: '优化建议';\n      description: '提供优化建议或特殊要求';\n    };\n  };\n  // 输出字段映射\n  outputs: {\n    // text: 处理结果文本\n    text: {\n      type: 'string';\n      source: 'llm_output';\n      description: 'LLM处理后的文本结果';\n    };\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 字段映射引擎\n */\nexport class FieldMappingEngine {\n  /**\n   * 将对话数据转换为工作流输入\n   * @param conversationData 对话数据\n   * @param mappingRules 字段映射规则\n   * @returns 工作流输入对象\n   */\n  mapInputFields(\n    conversationData: ConversationData,\n    mappingRules: FieldMappingRule[]\n  ): Record&lt;string, any&gt; {\n    const workflowInput: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n\n    for (const rule of mappingRules) {\n      let value: any;\n\n      if (rule.sourceType === 'field') {\n        // 字段映射：直接从对话数据提取字段\n        if (rule.sourceField === 'query') {\n          value = conversationData.query;\n        } else if (rule.sourceField === 'sources') {\n          value = conversationData.sources || [];\n        } else if (rule.sourceField === 'files') {\n          value = conversationData.files || [];\n        } else if (rule.sourceField === 'history') {\n          value = conversationData.history || [];\n        } else if (rule.sourceField === 'lastAssistantMessage') {\n          value = conversationData.lastAssistantMessage;\n        } else if (rule.sourceField === 'lastUserMessage') {\n          value = conversationData.lastUserMessage;\n        } else if (rule.sourceField === 'conversationId') {\n          value = conversationData.conversationId;\n        } else if (rule.sourceField === 'featureType') {\n          value = conversationData.featureType;\n        } else {\n          value = undefined;\n        }\n\n        // 如果值为空且提供了默认值，使用默认值\n        if ((value === undefined || value === null || value === '') &amp;&amp; rule.defaultValue !== undefined) {\n          value = rule.defaultValue;\n        }\n      } else if (rule.sourceType === 'expression') {\n        // 表达式映射：执行JavaScript表达式\n        try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentNodeExecutor implements NodeExecutor {\nasync execute(node: any, context: Record&lt;string, any&gt;): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n\n    }\n    \n    // Dify Agent 类型的原有逻辑\n    if (!role.difyConfig) throw new Error(&#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 的Dify配置不存在&#96;);\n    const { connectionType, apiKey, apiUrl } = role.difyConfig;\n    let actualBaseUrl = apiUrl;\n    if (apiUrl.startsWith('/')) actualBaseUrl = process.env.DIFY_BASE_URL || 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1';\n    const gateway = new DifyGateway({ baseUrl: actualBaseUrl, workflowBaseUrl: actualBaseUrl, apiKey, timeout: 60000, maxRetries: 3 });\n    const nodeInput = { ...context, ...(node.data?.inputs || {}) };\n    let query = nodeInput.query || nodeInput.input || nodeInput.workflowInput?.query || nodeInput.question || nodeInput.text || nodeInput.content;\n    if (!query) query = typeof nodeInput === 'string' ? nodeInput : JSON.stringify(nodeInput);\n    const inputs = { ...nodeInput };\n    delete inputs.query;\n    delete inputs.input;\n    if (connectionType === 'chatflow') {\n      const result = await gateway.executeChat({ query, conversationId: '', inputs, userId: 'todify3-user' });\n      if ((result as any).ok || (result as any).value) {\n        const raw = (result as any).value?.raw ??    - 后端 `buildConversationData` 中只在**第一次对话时**提取外部来源的 `description` 内容
   - 后续对话中，新增的来源内容不会被传递给AI

2. **来源分类在AI上下文中未体现**：

   - AI无法区分不同类型的来源，无法给予不同权重

3. **Dify API调用时来源信息丢失**：
   - `DifyGateway.executeChat()` 只传递 `query`、`inputs`、`conversation_id`
   - 来源的实际内容只是拼接到 query 字符串中，没有结构化传递

4. **性能问题**：
   - 每次都要遍历所有文件查找 markdown 内容
   - 大量来源时可能导致 query 过长

## 优化完成总结

### 1. 修复来源内容传递逻辑
- 移除了 `isFirstMessage` 限制
- 每次对话都会传递新增来源的 `description` 内容
- 同时处理 `external` 和 `knowledge_base` 类型的来源

### 2. 添加来源分类标签
- 新增 `getSourceCategoryLabel()` 方法
- 在传递给 AI 的上下文中标注来源类型（AI问答总结、技术包装问答、技术转译等）
- 帮助 AI 理解不同来源的重要性

### 3. 包含知识库来源内容
- 知识库来源的 `description` 也会被传递给 AI
- 不再只传递名称列表

### 4. 添加内容长度限制
- 限制单次传递的来源内容总长度为 8000 字符
- 超长时智能截断，优先保留高优先级来源（AI共创 > 技术资源 > 外部来源）
- 截断时显示提示信息

### 5. 优化侧边栏交互
- 添加分组折叠/展开功能（点击分组标题可折叠/展开）
- 显示每个分组的已选数量（"已选 X"）
- 使用 ChevronDown/ChevronUp 图标指示折叠状态

### 核心改进点

**后端优化** (`SendMessage.usecase.ts`):
- 按分类优先级排序来源（AI共创优先）
- 所有来源内容都会传递，不再受首次对话限制
- 智能截断机制，确保上下文不会过长

**前端优化** (`SourceSidebar.tsx`):
- 分组可折叠，提升大量来源时的浏览体验
- 实时显示已选数量，便于了解当前选择状态

这些优化解决了“AI 回答时没有充分利用勾选的来源信息”的问题，现在 AI 能够：
1. 在每次对话中都能获取到新增来源的完整内容
2. 理解不同来源的类型和重要性
3. 更好地引用和利用来源信息进行回答

所有修改已完成，代码已通过 linter 检查。

        "contents": "-- AI角色配置数据导入\n-- 此文件用于导入默认的AI角色配置信息\n-- 注意：DIFY_API_BASE_URL 会在初始化脚本中从环境变量替换\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 独立页面AI角色配置 (IndependentPageConfig)\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- AI问答\nINSERT OR REPLACE INTO ai_roles (\n    id, name, description, avatar, system_prompt, dify_config, enabled, source,\n    created_at, updated_at\n) VALUES (\n    'independent-page-ai-search',\n    'AI问答',\n    '智能问答和搜索功能',\n    NULL,\n    NULL,\n    json_object(\n        'apiUrl', '${DIFY_BASE_URL}',\n        'apiKey', 'app-HC8dx24idIWm1uva66VmHXsm',\n        'connectionType', 'chatflow'\n    ),\n    1,\n    'independent-page',\n    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 项目资源AI问答助手\nINSERT OR REPLACE INTO ai_roles (\n    id, name, description, avatar, system_prompt, dify_config, enabled, source,\n    created_at, updated_at\n) VALUES (\n    'project-resources-ai-qa',\n    'AI问答助手',\n    '基于项目资源进行智能问答',\n    NULL,\n    NULL,\n    json_object(\n        'apiUrl', '${DIFY_BASE_URL}',\n        'apiKey', 'app-HC8dx24idIWm1uva66VmHXsm',\n        'connectionType', 'chatflow'\n    ),\n    1,\n    'independent-page',\n    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 技术包装（主控 Agent - Direct Agent 类型，配置专家工具）\nINSERT OR REPLACE INTO ai_roles (\n    id, name, description, avatar, system_prompt, dify_config, enabled, source,\n    created_at, updated_at\n) VALUES (\n    'independent-page-tech-package',\n    '技术包装主控',\n    '技术包装主控Agent，作为营销总监协调四个专家工具完成技术包装任务',\n    NULL,\n    '你是一位资深的技术营销总监，负责协调技术包装工作。\n\n**你的职责：**\n1. 理解用户的技术包装需求\n2. 根据需求选择合适的专家工具进行分析\n3. 综合各专家的分析结果，给出专业建议\n\n**你可以使用以下专家工具：**\n- **Consult_Tech（技术原教旨主义者）**：提取硬核技术参数、物理原理、核心壁垒",

        "contents": "const AIRoleConfigInfoBox: React.FC&lt;AIRoleConfigInfoBoxProps&gt; = \nconst handleCreateAndAssignRole = async \n\n        \n        if (existingRole) {\n          result = { success: true, role: existingRole };\n        } else {\n          // 创建新角色（使用通用配置）\n          const response = await aiRoleService.createAIRole({\n            name: roleName,\n            description: roleDescription,\n            provider: 'direct-agent',\n            agentConfig: {\n              llm: {\n                provider: 'openai',\n                model: 'gpt-4o',\n                temperature: 0.7,\n                maxTokens: 2000,\n                apiKey: 'sk-placeholder-please-update',\n              },\n              prompt: {\n                systemPrompt: &#96;你是一位专业的${roleName}助手。你的任务是根据用户输入，提供专业、准确、有用的${roleName}相关服务。请仔细分析用户需求，提供结构化的输出。&#96;,\n              },\n              contextStrategy: {\n                type: 'window',\n                maxMessages: 20,\n                maxTokens: 4000,\n                includeSystemPrompt: true\n              }\n            },\n            enabled: true,\n            avatar: '🤖'\n          } as any);\n          \n          if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n            const newRole = {\n              ...response.data,\n              createdAt: new Date(response.data.createdAt),\n              updatedAt: new Date(response.data.updatedAt)\n            };\n            result = { success: true, role: newRole };\n          } else {\n            result = { success: false, error: response.message || response.error || '创建失败' };\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      \n      if (!result.success || !result.role) {\n        alert(&#96;创建角色失败: ${result.error}&#96;);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 2. 尝试自动分配给第一个字段映射配置\n      try\n;\n;",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./backend/src/scripts/create-ai-role-tables.sql",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 29
          }
        },
        "contents": "-- AI角色相关数据库表\n\n-- 1. AI角色表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_roles (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT NOT NULL,\n    avatar TEXT,                     -- 角色头像URL（可选）\n    system_prompt TEXT,               -- 系统提示词（可选）\n    dify_config TEXT NOT NULL,       -- JSON字符串，存储Dify配置（apiUrl, apiKey, connectionType, inputFields）\n    enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, -- 0或1，是否启用\n    source TEXT,                     -- 来源标记：'smart-workflow', 'independent-page', 'custom'\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_name ON ai_roles(name);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_enabled ON ai_roles(enabled);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_source ON ai_roles(source);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_updated ON ai_roles(updated_at DESC);\n\n-- 创建触发器，自动更新updated_at字段\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS update_ai_roles_updated_at\nAFTER UPDATE ON ai_roles\nBEGIN\n    UPDATE ai_roles SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\nEND;",

        "contents": "export class AIRoleModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建AI角色\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateAIRoleDTO): Promise&lt;AIRoleConfig&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    await this.initializeTable();\n\n    const id = data.id || &#96;ai-role-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(7)}&#96;;\n    const enabled = data.enabled !== undefined ? (data.enabled ? 1 : 0) : 1;\n\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO ai_roles (\n        id, name, description, avatar, system_prompt, dify_config, enabled, source,\n        created_at, updated_at\n      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)\n    &#96;;\n\n    // 根据 provider 决定存储的配置\n    let configToStore: any;\n    if (data.provider === 'direct-agent' &amp;&amp; data.agentConfig) {\n      configToStore = { provider: 'direct-agent', agentConfig: data.agentConfig };\n    } else {\n      configToStore = { provider: data.provider || 'dify', ...data.difyConfig };\n    }\n\n    const params = [\n      id,\n      data.name,\n      data.description,\n      data.avatar || null,\n      data.systemPrompt || null,\n      JSON.stringify(configToStore),\n      enabled,\n      data.source || null,\n    ];\n\n    await this.db.query(sql, params);\n\n    return await this.getById(id) as AIRoleConfig;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取AI角色\n   */\n  async getById(id: string): Promise&lt;AIRoleConfig | null&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 创建AI角色\n * POST /api/v1/ai-roles\n */\nrouter.post('/', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { name, description, avatar, systemPrompt, provider, difyConfig, agentConfig, enabled, source } = req.body;\n    \n    // 验证必填字段\n    if (!name || !description) {\n      return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n        field: 'name/description',\n        message: '角色名称和描述不能为空'\n      }]));\n    }\n\n    const actualProvider = provider || 'dify';\n    \n    // 根据 provider 验证配置\n    if (actualProvider === 'dify') {\n      if (!difyConfig) {\n        return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n          field: 'difyConfig',\n          message: 'Dify配置不能为空'\n        }]));\n      }\n      if (!difyConfig.apiUrl || !difyConfig.apiKey || !difyConfig.connectionType) {\n        return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n          field: 'difyConfig',\n          message: 'Dify配置必须包含apiUrl、apiKey和connectionType'\n        }]));\n      }\n    } else if (actualProvider === 'direct-agent') {\n      if (!agentConfig) {\n        return\n}",
