        "contents": "/**\n * 初始化所有AI角色配置\n */\nasync function initializeAIRoles(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  console.log('🚀 开始初始化AI角色配置...');\n  console.log(&#96;📍 Dify API Base URL: ${DIFY_API_BASE_URL}&#96;);\n  \n  try {\n    // 1. 创建表\n    await createAIRolesTable();\n    \n    // 2. 初始化独立页面角色\n    console.log('\\n📝 初始化独立页面AI角色...');\n    for (const role of INDEPENDENT_PAGE_ROLES) {\n      await upsertAIRole(role, 'independent-page', 'chatflow');\n    }\n    \n    // 3. 初始化智能工作流角色（可选）\n    console.log('\\n📝 初始化智能工作流AI角色...');\n    for (const role of SMART_WORKFLOW_ROLES) {\n      await upsertAIRole(role, 'smart-workflow', role.connectionType);\n    }\n    \n    console.log('\\n🎉 AI角色配置初始化完成！');\n    \n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('❌ 初始化失败:', error);\n    throw error;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 显示当前AI角色列表\n */\nasync function displayAIRoles(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  try\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 插入或更新AI角色\n */\nasync function upsertAIRole(\n  role: IndependentPageRole | SmartWorkflowRole,\n  source: 'independent-page' | 'smart-workflow',\n  connectionType: 'chatflow' | 'workflow' = 'chatflow'\n): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 检查角色是否已存在\n    const checkSql = 'SELECT id FROM ai_roles WHERE id = ?';\n    const existing = await db.query(checkSql, [role.id]);\n    \n    // 准备Dify配置\n    const difyConfig = {\n      apiUrl: DIFY_API_BASE_URL,\n      apiKey: role.apiKey,\n      connectionType: connectionType,\n    };\n    \n    if (existing.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 更新现有角色\n      const updateSql = &#96;\n        UPDATE ai_roles \n        SET name = ?, \n            description = ?, \n            dify_config = ?,\n            enabled = 1,\n            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        WHERE id = ?\n      &#96;;\n      \n      await db.query(updateSql, [\n        role.name,\n        role.description,\n        JSON.stringify(difyConfig),\n        role.id,\n      ]);\n      \n      console.log(&#96;🔄 更新角色: ${role.name} (${role.id})&#96;);\n    } else {\n      // 插入新角色\n      const insertSql = &#96;\n        INSERT INTO ai_roles (\n          id, name, description, avatar, system_prompt, dify_config, enabled, source,\n          created_at, updated_at\n        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)\n      &#96;;\n      \n      await db.query(insertSql, [\n        role.id,\n        role.name,\n        role.description,\n        null, // avatar\n        null, // system_prompt\n        JSON.stringify(difyConfig),\n        1, // enabled\n        source,\n      ]);\n      \n      console.log(&#96;✅ 创建角色: ${role.name} (${role.id})&#96;);\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(&#96;❌ 处理角色 ${role.name} (${role.id}) 失败:&#96;, error);\n    throw error;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 初始化所有AI角色配置\n */\nasync function initializeAIRoles(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  console.log('🚀 开始初始化AI角色配置...');\n}",

        "contents": "-- 市场狙击手\nINSERT OR REPLACE INTO ai_roles (\n    id, name, description, avatar, system_prompt, dify_config, enabled, source,\n    created_at, updated_at\n) VALUES (\n    'market-sniper',\n    '市场狙击手',\n    '制定精准的市场传播策略，分析竞品并寻找差异化定位',\n    NULL,\n    '你是一位市场策略专家，擅长分析竞品打法，制定差异化的传播策略和攻击方案。\n\n**核心职责：**\n- 分析竞品的技术路线和传播策略\n- 识别自身技术的差异化优势\n- 制定精准的市场定位和传播话术\n- 提供攻击性策略和概念定义建议\n\n**工作原则：**\n1. **竞品洞察**：深入分析竞品的技术路线、传播策略和用户心智\n2. **差异化定位**：找到自身技术的独特价值点和竞争壁垒\n3. **精准打击**：制定有针对性的传播策略，直击竞品弱点\n4. **概念包装**：将技术优势包装成易于传播的概念和Slogan\n\n**输出要求：**\n- 竞品分析：列出主要竞品的技术特点和传播策略\n- 差异化优势：明确自身技术的独特价值点\n- 传播策略：提供3-5个核心传播方向和话术建议\n- Slogan建议：提供2-3个易于传播的Slogan或概念\n- 攻击策略：指出竞品的弱点和可攻击的维度\n\n请保持战略思维，既要客观分析，也要有攻击性思维，帮助客户在激烈的市场竞争中脱颖而出。',\n    json_object(\n        'provider', 'direct-agent',",

        },
        "contents": "async (req, res) =&gt; {\n {\n      if (!agentConfig) {\n        return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n          field: 'agentConfig',\n          message: 'Direct Agent配置不能为空'\n        }]));\n      }\n      if (!agentConfig.llm || !agentConfig.llm.apiKey || !agentConfig.llm.model) {\n        return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n          field: 'agentConfig',\n          message: 'Direct Agent配置必须包含llm.apiKey和llm.model'\n        }]));\n      }\n      if (!agentConfig.prompt || !agentConfig.prompt.systemPrompt) {\n        return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n          field: 'agentConfig',\n          message: 'Direct Agent配置必须包含prompt.systemPrompt'\n        }]));\n      }\n      if (!agentConfig.contextStrategy) {\n        return res.status(400).json(formatValidationErrorResponse([{\n          field: 'agentConfig',\n          message: 'Direct Agent配置必须包含contextStrategy'\n        }]));\n      }\n    }\n    \n    const createData: CreateAIRoleDTO = {\n      name,\n      description,\n      avatar,\n      systemPrompt,\n      provider: actualProvider,\n      difyConfig,\n      agentConfig,\n      enabled,\n      source,\n    };\n    \n    const newRole = await aiRoleModel.create(createData);\n    \n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, newRole, '创建AI角色成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('创建AI角色失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(\n      false,\n      null,\n      '创建AI角色失败',\n      error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n    ));\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 更新AI角色\n * PUT /api/v1/ai-roles/:id\n */\nrouter.put",
        "signatures": {
          "ranges": [
            {
              "startPosition": {
                "line": 166,
                "column": 1
              },

        "contents": "export const createPresetRole = async (featureType: string): Promise&lt;{ success: boolean; role?: AIRoleConfig; error?: string }&gt; =&gt; {\n  const config = PRESET_ROLES[featureType];\n  if (!config) {\n    return { success: false, error: '未找到预设配置' };\n  }\n\n  try {\n    // 检查是否已存在同名角色\n    const existingRoles = await aiRoleService.getAIRoles();\n    const existingRole = existingRoles.find(r =&gt; r.name === config.name);\n    \n    if (existingRole) {\n      return { success: true, role: existingRole };\n    }\n\n    // 创建新角色\n    const response = await aiRoleService.createAIRole({\n      ...config,\n      enabled: true,\n      avatar: '🤖' // 默认头像\n    } as any);\n\n    if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        // 转换返回的数据以匹配AIRoleConfig类型\n        const newRole = {\n            ...response.data,\n            createdAt: new Date(response.data.createdAt),\n            updatedAt: new Date(response.data.updatedAt)\n        };\n      return { success: true, role: newRole };\n    } else {\n      return { success: false, error: response.message || response.error || '创建失败' };\n    }\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    return { success: false, error: error.message || '创建过程发生错误' };\n  }\n};",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./backend/init-data/02-ai-roles-config.sql",

          }

        "contents": "请用温暖、人性化的语言，让技术变得有温度、有故事。',\n    json_object(\n        'provider', 'direct-agent',\n        'agentConfig', json_object(\n            'llm', json_object(\n                'provider', 'openai',\n                'apiKey', '',\n                'apiBaseUrl', '',\n                'model', 'gpt-4o',\n                'temperature', 0.7,\n                'maxTokens', 4000\n            ),\n            'prompt', json_object(\n                'systemPrompt', '你是一位场景洞察专家，擅长将生硬的技术参数转化为用户能感知的真实场景和情绪价值。\\n\\n**核心职责：**\\n- 将技术点映射为用户的高频痛点或爽点场景\\n- 构建生动的用户故事和使用场景\\n- 提炼技术的情绪价值和情感共鸣点\\n- 用\"人话\"解释技术带来的实际改变\\n\\n**工作原则：**\\n1. **用户视角**：站在用户角度思考技术带来的实际改变\\n2. **场景化表达**：用具体的使用场景替代抽象的技术参数\\n3. **情绪共鸣**：挖掘技术背后的情感价值和用户痛点\\n4. **故事化叙述**：用故事化的方式让技术更容易被理解\\n\\n**输出要求：**\\n- 提供3-5个核心用户场景，每个场景包含：\\n  - 场景描述（何时、何地、何人）\\n  - 用户痛点或需求\\n  - 技术如何解决该问题\\n  - 用户获得的情绪价值\\n- 用通俗易懂的语言，避免技术术语\\n- 突出技术带来的实际改变和用户收益\\n\\n请用温暖、人性化的语言，让技术变得有温度、有故事。',\n                'variables', json_array()\n            ),\n            'contextStrategy', json_object(\n                'type', 'window',\n                'maxMessages', 20,\n                'maxTokens', 2000,\n                'includeSystemPrompt', true\n            )\n        )\n    ),\n    1,\n    'expert-tool',\n    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 市场狙击手\nINSERT OR REPLACE INTO ai_roles (\n    id, name, description, avatar, system_prompt, dify_config, enabled, source,",

        "contents": "# 项目节点配置指南\n\n本文档详细说明了项目中需要配置AI角色的所有节点及其配置方法。\n\n## 一、需要配置的节点分类\n\n### 1. 独立页面节点（5个）\n\n这些节点在独立页面模式下使用，需要创建source为\"independent-page\"的AI角色。\n\n| 节点类型 | 节点名称 | 路径 | 匹配规则 |\n|---------|---------|------|---------|\n| &#96;ai-search&#96; | AI问答 | &#96;/node/ai-search&#96; | 匹配ID/名称/描述包含\"ai-search\"、\"ai问答\"、\"智能搜索\"等 |\n| &#96;tech-package&#96; | 技术包装 | &#96;/node/tech-package&#96; | 匹配ID/名称/描述包含\"tech-package\"、\"技术包装\"等 |\n| &#96;promotion-strategy&#96; | 技术策略 | &#96;/node/promotion-strategy&#96; | 匹配ID/名称/描述包含\"promotion-strategy\"、\"tech-strategy\"、\"技术策略\"等 |\n| &#96;core-draft&#96; | 技术通稿 | &#96;/node/core-draft&#96; | 匹配ID/名称/描述包含\"core-draft\"、\"tech-article\"、\"技术通稿\"等 |\n| &#96;speech&#96; | 发布会演讲稿 | &#96;/node/speech&#96; | 匹配ID/名称/描述包含\"speech\"、\"发布会\"、\"演讲稿\"等 |\n\n**配置方法**：\n1. 在AI角色管理页面创建新角色\n2. 设置source为\"independent-page\"\n3. 角色ID、名称或描述需要匹配上述规则\n4. 系统会自动匹配并应用\n\n### 2. 工作流Agent节点\n\n在工作流编辑器中创建的Agent节点，需要为每个节点配置agentId。\n\n**配置方法**：\n1. 进入工作流编辑器（&#96;/agent-workflow&#96;）\n2. 创建或编辑工作流\n3. 添加Agent节点\n4. 在节点配置中选择对应的AI角色（agentId）\n5. 注意：工作流中的Agent节点只支持Dify类型的角色，不支持Direct Agent类型\n\n**相关代码位置**：\n- &#96;backend/src/services/AgentWorkflowService.ts&#96; - &#96;executeAgentNode()&#96;方法\n- &#96;frontend/src/components/WorkflowEditor/AgentNode.tsx&#96; - Agent节点组件\n\n### 3. 字段映射功能对象（8个）\n\n在字段映射配置中，可以为每个功能对象配置专属的agentId或workflowId。\n\n| 功能类型 | 功能名称 | 配置位置 |\n|---------|---------|---------|\n| &#96;five-view-analysis&#96; | 技术转译（五看） | 字段映射管理页面 |",

        "contents": "export class ContextManager {\nprivate async applyHybridStrategy(\n    history: any[],\n    strategy: DirectAgentConfig['contextStrategy'],\n    currentQuery: string\n  ): Promise&lt;ChatMessage[]&gt; {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 生成摘要\n   * @param messages 消息列表\n   * @returns 摘要文本\n   */\n  private async generateSummary(messages: any[]): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    if (messages.length === 0) {\n      return '';\n    }\n\n    try {\n      // 构建摘要提示词\n      const conversationText = messages\n        .map(msg =&gt; {\n          const role = msg.message_type === 'user' ? '用户' : '助手';\n          const content = msg.content || msg.query || msg.dify_answer || '';\n          return &#96;${role}: ${content}&#96;;\n        })\n        .join('\\n');\n\n      // 如果对话文本太长，截断（避免超出 token 限制）\n      const maxLength = 2000; // 大约 500 tokens\n      const truncatedText = conversationText.length &gt; maxLength \n        ? conversationText.substring(0, maxLength) + '...'\n        : conversationText;\n\n      const summaryPrompt = &#96;请总结以下对话的关键信息，保留重要的上下文和细节。用中文回答，控制在100字以内。\n\n对话内容：\n${truncatedText}\n\n摘要：&#96;;\n\n      // 尝试使用环境变量中的 OpenAI API Key 生成摘要\n      // 如果没有配置，则返回简化摘要\n      const apiKey = process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY;\n      if (apiKey) {\n        try {\n          const provider = new OpenAIProvider(apiKey);\n          const summaryMessages: ChatMessage[] = [\n            {\n              role: 'user',\n              content: summaryPrompt\n            }\n          ];\n          \n          const response = await provider.chat(summaryMessages, {\n            provider: 'openai',\n            apiKey,\n            model: 'gpt-3.5-turbo',\n            temperature: 0.3,\n            maxTokens: 200\n          });\n          \n          return response.content || '';\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.warn('使用 LLM 生成摘要失败，使用简化摘要:', error);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 降级方案：返回简化的摘要（前200字符）\n      const text = conversationText.substring(0, 200);\n      return text + (conversationText.length &gt; 200 ? '...' : '');\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class OpenAIProvider implements ILLMProvider {\nasync chat(messages: ChatMessage[], config: LLMConfig, tools?: Tool[]): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\n\n    \n    // 重试逻辑\n    for (let attempt = 0; attempt &lt; this.maxRetries; attempt++) {\n      try {\n        const response = await axios.post(url, requestBody, {\n          headers: {\n            'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${this.apiKey}&#96;,\n            'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n          },\n          timeout: this.timeout,\n        });\n\n        return this.parseResponse(response.data);\n      } catch (error) {\n        lastError = error as Error;\n        \n        // 如果是网络错误或超时，重试\n        if (this.isRetryableError(error)) {\n          if (attempt &lt; this.maxRetries - 1) {\n            // 指数退避\n            await this.sleep(Math.pow(2, attempt) * 1000);\n            continue;\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果是客户端错误（4xx），不重试\n        if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {\n          const axiosError = error as AxiosError;\n          if (axiosError.response &amp;&amp; axiosError.response.status &gt;= 400 &amp;&amp; axiosError.response.status &lt; 500) {\n            throw this.handleError(error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    throw this.handleError(lastError || new Error('未知错误'));\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 测试连接\n   */\n  async testConnection(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// Web Search API\nrouter.post('/web-search', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { query, freshness, summary, count, include, exclude }: BochaWebSearchRequest = req.body;\n\n    // 验证必填参数\n    if (!query || !query.trim()) {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: 'MISSING_PARAMETER',\n          message: '缺少必填参数: query'\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 检查 API Key\n    if (!BOCHA_API_KEY) {\n      console.error('BOCHA_API_KEY 未配置');\n      return res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: 'CONFIG_ERROR',\n          message: '博查 API Key 未配置，请在环境变量中设置 BOCHA_API_KEY'\n        }\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 构建请求体\n    const requestBody: BochaWebSearchRequest = {\n      query: query.trim(),\n      summary: summary !== undefined ? summary : true,\n      count: count &amp;&amp; count &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; count &lt;= 50 ? count : 10,\n    };\n\n    if (freshness) {\n      requestBody.freshness = freshness;\n    }\n    if (include) {\n      requestBody.include = include;\n    }\n    if (exclude) {\n      requestBody.exclude = exclude;\n    }\n\n    // 调用博查 API\n    const response = await axios.post(BOCHA_API_URL, requestBody, {\n      headers: {\n        'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${BOCHA_API_KEY}&#96;,\n        'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n      },\n      timeout: 30000, // 30秒超时\n    });\n\n    // 返回结果\n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: response.data.data || response.data,\n      log_id: response.data.log_id\n    });\n\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('博查 Web Search API 调用失败:', error);\n\n    // 处理 axios 错误\n    if (error.response)\n}",

        "contents": "export class LocalProvider implements ILLMProvider {\nconstructor(apiBaseUrl: string) {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 发送聊天请求\n   */\n  async chat(messages: ChatMessage[], config: LLMConfig, tools?: Tool[]): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\n    // 尝试使用 OpenAI 兼容的 API\n    const url = &#96;${this.apiBaseUrl}/chat/completions&#96;;\n\n    const requestBody: any = {\n      model: config.model,\n      messages: this.formatMessages(messages),\n      temperature: config.temperature,\n      max_tokens: config.maxTokens,\n    };\n\n    if (config.topP !== undefined) {\n      requestBody.top_p = config.topP;\n    }\n\n    // 添加工具定义（如果提供）\n    if (tools &amp;&amp; tools.length &gt; 0) {\n      requestBody.tools = tools;\n      requestBody.tool_choice = 'auto';\n    }\n\n    let lastError: Error | null = null;\n    \n    // 重试逻辑\n    for (let attempt = 0; attempt &lt; this.maxRetries; attempt++) {\n      try {\n        const response = await axios.post(url, requestBody, {\n          headers: {\n            'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n          },\n          timeout: this.timeout,\n        });\n\n        return this.parseResponse(response.data);\n      } catch (error) {\n        lastError = error as Error;\n        \n        // 如果是网络错误或超时，重试\n        if (this.isRetryableError(error)) {\n          if (attempt &lt; this.maxRetries - 1) {\n            // 指数退避\n            await this.sleep(Math.pow(2, attempt) * 1000);\n            continue;\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果是客户端错误（4xx），不重试\n        if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {\n          const axiosError = error as AxiosError;\n          if (axiosError.response &amp;&amp; axiosError.response.status &gt;= 400 &amp;&amp; axiosError.response.status &lt; 500) {\n            throw this.handleError(error);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    throw this.handleError(lastError || new Error('未知错误'));\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 测试连接\n   */\n  async testConnection(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 获取工作流配置\n * GET /api/v1/ai-search/workflow?pageType=tech-package|press-release\n */\nrouter.get('/workflow', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string | undefined; // 'tech-package' | 'press-release'\n    const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows() as any[];\n    \n    // 根据页面类型选择不同的环境变量或默认工作流\n    let workflowIdFromEnv: string | null = null;\n    if (pageType === 'press-release') {\n      workflowIdFromEnv = process.env.PRESS_RELEASE_WORKFLOW_ID || process.env.AI_SEARCH_WORKFLOW_ID || null;\n    } else {\n      workflowIdFromEnv = process.env.AI_SEARCH_WORKFLOW_ID || null;\n    }\n\n    let resolvedWorkflowId: string | null = null;\n    const workflowsArray = workflows as any[];\n\n    if (workflowIdFromEnv) {\n      const matched = workflowsArray.find((workflow: any) =&gt; workflow.id === workflowIdFromEnv);\n      if (matched) {\n        resolvedWorkflowId = matched.id;\n      } else {\n        logger.warn('工作流ID指定的工作流不存在，已自动回退', {\n          workflowId: workflowIdFromEnv,\n          pageType,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!resolvedWorkflowId) {\n      // 根据页面类型选择默认工作流名称\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflowsArray.find((workflow: any) =&gt; workflow.name === defaultWorkflowName);\n      resolvedWorkflowId = defaultWorkflow?.id || workflowsArray[0]?.id || null;\n    }\n\n    res.json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        true,\n        { workflowId: resolvedWorkflowId },\n        '获取工作流配置成功'\n      )\n    );\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '获取工作流配置失败',\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n      )\n    );\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 文件上传\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/upload\n */\nrouter.post",

        "contents": "// Dify聊天消息代理\nrouter.post('/chat-messages', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    console.log('=== Dify Chat Messages Proxy ===');\n    console.log('Request body:', req.body);\n    \n    const { appType, apiKey: clientApiKey, ...requestBody } = req.body;\n    const apiKey = getApiKey(appType) || clientApiKey;\n\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      console.error('API key is missing for appType:', appType);\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'API key is required' });\n    }\n\n    console.log('Using API key for appType:', appType);\n    console.log('API Key (first 10 chars):', apiKey.substring(0, 10) + '...');\n    \n    // 直接使用Dify后端地址（9999端口）\n    const difyBaseUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1';\n    console.log('Dify base URL:', difyBaseUrl);\n\n    // 清理requestBody，确保只发送Dify需要的字段\n    const { appType: _, ...cleanedBody } = requestBody;\n    \n    console.log('发送给Dify的请求体:', {\n      query: cleanedBody.query,\n      inputs: cleanedBody.inputs,\n      conversation_id: cleanedBody.conversation_id,\n      response_mode: 'blocking'\n    });\n\n    // 正确的Dify API端点\n    const difyApiUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/chat-messages';\n    console.log('请求Dify API URL:', difyApiUrl);\n    \n    // 构建请求体，只在有有效conversation_id时才包含它\n    const requestPayload: any = {\n      query: cleanedBody.query,\n      inputs: cleanedBody.inputs || {},\n      user: requestBody.user || &#96;user-${Date.now()}&#96;, \n      response_mode: 'blocking'\n    };\n    \n    // 只在有有效conversation_id时才添加它\n    if (cleanedBody.conversation_id &amp;&amp; cleanedBody.conversation_id.trim() !== '') {\n      requestPayload.conversation_id = cleanedBody.conversation_id;\n    }\n    \n    console.log('最终发送给Dify的请求体:', requestPayload);\n    \n    const difyResponse = await axios.post\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\nasync executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\n\n    \n    try {\n      // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\n      checkTimeout();\n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'load_config', {\n        type: 'config',\n        input: { roleId },\n        output: null,\n        duration: 0,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\n      if (!role) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      if (!role.agentConfig) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const config = role.agentConfig;\n\n      // 2. 生成或使用 conversationId\n      const finalConversationId = conversationId || this.generateConversationId();\n      this.currentConversationId = finalConversationId; // 保存当前对话ID\n      this.toolCallsHistory = []; // 重置工具调用历史\n\n      // 3. 检查 prompt 配置\n      if (!config.prompt) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent prompt配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      if (!config.prompt.systemPrompt) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent systemPrompt配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      // 4. 渲染 System Prompt\n      const promptStartTime = Date.now();\n      const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\n        config.prompt.systemPrompt,\n        config.prompt.variables || [],\n        context\n      );\n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'render_prompt', {\n        type: 'prompt',\n        input: { systemPrompt: config.prompt.systemPrompt, variables: config.prompt.variables, context },\n        output: { systemPrompt },\n        duration: Date.now() - promptStartTime,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      // 4. 获取上下文消息\n      checkTimeout();\n      const contextStartTime = Date.now();\n      const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\n        finalConversationId,\n        config.contextStrategy,\n        query\n      );\n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'load_context', {\n        type: 'context',\n        input:\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// Dify工作流代理\nrouter.post('/workflows/run', async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    console.log('=== Dify Workflow Proxy ===');\n    console.log('Request body:', req.body);\n    \n    const { appType, apiKey: clientApiKey, ...requestBody } = req.body;\n    const apiKey = getApiKey(appType) || clientApiKey;\n\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      console.error('API key is missing for appType:', appType);\n      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'API key is required' });\n    }\n\n    console.log('Using API key for appType:', appType);\n    // 直接使用正确的Dify工作流API端点\n    const difyWorkflowUrl = 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/workflows/run';\n    console.log('Dify workflow URL:', difyWorkflowUrl);\n\n    const difyResponse = await axios.post(\n      difyWorkflowUrl,\n      { \n        ...requestBody, \n        user: requestBody.user || &#96;user-${Date.now()}&#96;, \n        response_mode: 'blocking' \n      },\n      {\n        headers: {\n          'Authorization': &#96;Bearer ${apiKey}&#96;,\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        },\n        timeout: 60000,\n      }\n    );\n    \n    console.log('Dify workflow response received:', difyResponse.status);\n    res.json(difyResponse.data);\n  } catch (error: any) {\n    console.error('Dify workflow proxy error:', error.message);\n    console.error('Error details:', error.response?.data);\n    res.status(error.response?.status || 500).json({\n      error: error.response?.data || error.message\n    });\n  }\n});\n\nexport default router;",

        "contents": "export class AgentNodeExecutor implements NodeExecutor {\nasync execute(node: any, context: Record&lt;string, any&gt;): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n\n    }\n    \n    // Dify Agent 类型的原有逻辑\n    if (!role.difyConfig) throw new Error(&#96;AI角色 ${agentId} 的Dify配置不存在&#96;);\n    const { connectionType, apiKey, apiUrl } = role.difyConfig;\n    let actualBaseUrl = apiUrl;\n    if (apiUrl.startsWith('/')) actualBaseUrl = process.env.DIFY_BASE_URL || 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1';\n    const gateway = new DifyGateway({ baseUrl: actualBaseUrl, workflowBaseUrl: actualBaseUrl, apiKey, timeout: 60000, maxRetries: 3 });\n    const nodeInput = { ...context, ...(node.data?.inputs || {}) };\n    let query = nodeInput.query || nodeInput.input || nodeInput.workflowInput?.query || nodeInput.question || nodeInput.text || nodeInput.content;\n    if (!query) query = typeof nodeInput === 'string' ? nodeInput : JSON.stringify(nodeInput);\n    const inputs = { ...nodeInput };\n    delete inputs.query;\n    delete inputs.input;\n    if (connectionType === 'chatflow') {\n      const result = await gateway.executeChat({ query, conversationId: '', inputs, userId: 'todify3-user' });\n      if ((result as any).ok || (result as any).value) {\n        const raw = (result as any).value?.raw ?? (result as any).raw;\n        return { answer: raw?.answer || (result as any).value?.answer, conversation_id: raw?.conversation_id, raw };\n      }\n      throw new Error((result as any).error?.message || 'Dify聊天调用失败');\n    } else {\n      const result = await gateway.executeWorkflow({ workflowId: 'workflow', inputs, userId: 'todify3-user' });\n      if ((result as any).ok || (result as any).value) {\n        const raw = (result as any).value?.raw ?? (result as any).raw;\n        return { result: raw?.data?.outputs?.text || raw?.data?.outputs?.answer || '', raw };\n      }\n      throw new Error((result as any).error?.message || 'Dify工作流调用失败');\n    }\n  }\n}",

## 完成总结

### 1. 创建的文件

1. **`backend/src/scripts/init-tech-qa-role.ts`**
   - TypeScript 初始化脚本
   - 自动检测并创建/更新角色
   - 支持环境变量配置

2. **`backend/init-data/03-ai-tech-qa-role.sql`**
   - SQL 初始化脚本（备选方案）
   - 包含完整的角色配置

3. **`backend/init-data/README-tech-qa-role.md`**
   - 使用说明文档
   - 包含安装、配置、使用方法

### 2. 角色配置特点

**角色ID**: `tech-general-qa-assistant`  
**角色名称**: AI技术通用问答助手

**核心配置**:
- Provider: `direct-agent` (直接使用 OpenAI API)
- Model: `gpt-4o`
- Temperature: `0.3` (较低温度，确保准确性)
- Max Tokens: `4000`
- Context Window: `8000 tokens`, `30 messages`

**系统提示词重点**:
1. 来源分类识别：区分 AI 共创信息、技术资源、外部来源
2. 信息解读流程：通读→识别→关联→提取
3. 回答构建策略：直接回答、综合分析、部分回答、无法回答
4. 来源标注格式：【来源：XXX】或【综合来源：XXX、YYY】
5. 回答质量要求：准确性、完整性、可读性、结构化

### 3. 使用方法

**快速安装**:
```bash
cd backend
ts-node src/scripts/init-tech-qa-role.ts
```

**环境变量配置**:
```bash
export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-your-openai-api-key"
```

### 4. 与来源信息处理的集成

该角色与之前优化的来源信息处理机制配合：
- 后端会传递所有来源的 `description` 内容（不再受首次对话限制）
- 来源信息会按分类标签组织（AI共创、技术资源、外部来源）
- 角色会按照系统提示词深度解读这些来源信息
- 回答时会明确标注信息来源

### 5. 下一步

1. 运行初始化脚本创建角色
2. 在 AI 问答页面配置使用此角色
3. 测试角色对来源信息的解读能力

Thus it is not recommended for production."

                {

                  "content": "It is important to differentiate between errors from ts-node, errors from the TypeScript compiler, and errors from &#96;node&#96;.                 {

Instead, ts-node starts with the script file (e.g. &#96;ts-node index.ts&#96;) and TypeScript resolves dependencies based on imports and references."
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 1056,

                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 1060,

                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 1062,
                  "content": "To skip typechecking in ts-node, do one of the following:"

                {
                  "lineNumber": 1082,
                  "content": "ts-node works by registering hooks for &#96;.ts&#96;, &#96;.tsx&#96;, &#96;.js&#96;, and/or &#96;.jsx&#96; extensions."

                },

                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 1111,
                  "content": "By default, ts-node avoids compiling files in &#96;/node_modules/&#96; for three reasons:"

                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 1123,

                  "lineNumber": 1147,

                  "content": "# ts-node-dev"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 3,
                  "content": "&gt; Tweaked version of [node-dev](https://github.com/fgnass/node-dev) that uses [ts-node](https://github.com/TypeStrong/ts-node) under the hood."
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 5,
                  "content": "It restarts target node process when any of required files changes (as standard &#96;node-dev&#96;) but shares [Typescript](https://github.com/Microsoft/TypeScript/) compilation process between restarts. This significantly increases speed of restarting comparing to &#96;node-dev -r ts-node/register ...&#96;, &#96;nodemon -x ts-node ...&#96; variations because there is no need to instantiate &#96;ts-node&#96; compilation each time."
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 9,
                  "content": "![npm (scoped)](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/ts-node-dev.svg?maxAge=86400) [![Build Status](https://travis-ci.com/wclr/ts-node-dev.svg?branch=master)](https://travis-ci.com/wclr/ts-node-dev)"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 12,
                  "content": "yarn add ts-node-dev --dev"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 16,
                  "content": "npm i ts-node-dev --save-dev"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 22,
                  "content": "ts-node-dev [node-dev|ts-node flags] [ts-node-dev flags] [node cli flags] [--] [script] [script arguments]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 25,
                  "content": "So you just combine [node-dev](https://github.com/fgnass/node-dev) and [ts-node](https://github.com/TypeStrong/ts-node) options (see docs of those packages):"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 28,
                  "content": "ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only server.ts"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 31,
                  "content": "There is also short alias &#96;tsnd&#96; for running &#96;ts-node-dev&#96;:"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 37,
                  "content": "Look up flags and options can be used [in ts-node's docs](https://github.com/TypeStrong/ts-node#cli-and-programmatic-options)."
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 39,
                  "content": "**Also there are additional options specific to &#96;ts-node-dev&#96;:**"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 56,
                  "content": "If you need to detect that you are running with &#96;ts-node-dev&#96;, check if &#96;process.env.TS_NODE_DEV&#96; is set."
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 63,
                  "content": "- Especially for large code bases always consider running with &#96;--transpile-only&#96; flag which is normal for dev workflow and will speed up things greatly. Note, that &#96;ts-node-dev&#96; will not put watch handlers on TS files that contain only types/interfaces (used only for type checking) - this is current limitation by design."
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 70,

                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 73,

已修复。现在可以使用以下方式运行脚本：

## 修复内容

1. 在 `package.json` 中添加了 npm script：
   ```json
   "init:tech-qa-role": "ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/init-tech-qa-role.ts"
   ```

2. 更新了 README 文档，说明三种运行方式

## 现在可以运行

```bash
cd backend
npm run init:tech-qa-role
```

或者使用其他方式：

```bash
# 方式2：使用 npx
npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/init-tech-qa-role.ts

# 方式3：使用本地路径
./node_modules/.bin/ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/scripts/init-tech-qa-role.ts
```

**注意**：运行前请确保已设置环境变量：
```bash
export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-your-openai-api-key"
```

现在可以直接运行 `npm run init:tech-qa-role` 来创建AI技术通用问答角色了。
